description_text:
About The Company

Paid per approved task, about $100/hr equivalent. One flat rate for every approved task.

Built to fit around a clinical practice:

Tasks estimated at about 10-20 hrs/week while the project is active; you choose when and how much to contribute
Contribute anytime, from anywhere
No patient contact, no malpractice exposure: you review written clinical cases
All reviewers are license-verified physicians
$50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first production task is approved

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based.

What This Opportunity Involves

We're looking for actively practicing, US-licensed physicians (MD/DO) living outside the US, with an active, unrestricted US medical license, to evaluate clinical EHR vignettes for a medical AI evaluation project. General and internal medicine are the main focus. On this project, contributors may:

Evaluate clinical EHR vignettes paired with a question, a proposed answer, and a distractor "trap" answer across diagnosis and treatment tasks, spanning cardiovascular, nervous, hematologic, respiratory, digestive, urinary, reproductive, musculoskeletal, and integumentary systems;
Score the clinical reasoning quality of benchmark items: vignette accuracy and completeness, whether the vignette gives the answer away, answer correctness and gradeability, and trap quality;
Check whether the reasoning chain reaches the answer from vignette facts alone, correct reasoning traces, and write short rationales;
Work within three independent blind reads, followed by physician adjudication. Real clinical complexity only. You're improving the AI tools you'll eventually use yourself

If you're a practicing physician ready to take on this challenging and engaging project, apply to take part!

What We Look For

This opportunity is a good fit for US-licensed physicians living outside the US who are looking for a flexible, time-limited project they can fit around clinical practice. Ideally, contributors will have:

Medical degree (MD or DO) and an active, unrestricted US medical license (verified at onboarding and re-checked monthly);
Board certification or completed residency training, with recent direct patient care (attending-level preferred);
Broad, multi-system diagnostic and treatment experience (internal, family, emergency, or hospital medicine);
Strong clinical reasoning: differential diagnosis, next-step management, and application of evidence-based guidelines;
Prior experience in medical AI evaluation, clinical content or exam-question review, or medical annotation/QA (a plus);
Strong written English (C1+)

This opportunity is not suitable for medical students, unlicensed medical graduates, non-physician clinicians (NPs, PAs, nurses, pharmacists), or non-clinical healthcare titles.

How It Works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

How To Apply

Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Project time expectations 

You decide when and how much to contribute. For this project, tasks are estimated at around 10-20 hours per week during active phases. This is an estimate, not a minimum or a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active. Tasks are submitted within the project timeline and need to meet the listed acceptance criteria to be approved.

Earnings

Earnings are per approved task, at a flat rate set to about $100/hr equivalent based on estimated task time. There are no tiers or speed adjustments to the base rate. QA and adjudication tasks are paid at a higher rate.

$50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first production task is approved
Incentives: additional earnings for high-quality approved tasks. Terms are shared in the project guidelines

description_text:
We're looking for an experienced bilingual professional who is fluent in Arabic and English to help train AI models. You'll put the newest AI models to work on realistic tasks drawn from your own language expertise, judge what they produce with a native speaker's ear, and tell us exactly where they hold up and where they fall apart.

This is a fast-growing area for our company, focused on teaching AI to communicate naturally across languages and cultures. The models can already produce fluent-looking Arabic. What they can't yet do reliably is tell "correct" from "natural": the right dialect, register, idiom and cultural context. Your language instincts, cultural knowledge and written reasoning become the signal that shapes the next generation of multilingual AI.

What You'll Do

Write challenging, realistic prompts and conversations in Arabic and English, drawn from your own experience (a translation, a customer support exchange, a business email, a lesson plan)
Evaluate AI responses the way you'd review a colleague's work: accuracy, fluency, grammar, tone, register, and whether it followed the request
Compare two AI responses to the same prompt and make the call on which performed better and where each fell short
Critique AI-generated translations, conversations, summaries and written content, and explain your reasoning clearly
Flag concrete failures with evidence, such as mistranslations, overly literal phrasing, wrong dialect or register, grammar errors, cultural missteps, or ignored instructions
Contribute across a wide range of language tasks and subject areas

Projects Span

Translation and localization: Arabic to English, English to Arabic, and adapting content for regional audiences
Conversation and support: customer service, administrative and virtual assistant scenarios
Writing and editing: business, creative and educational content
Education: tutoring, grammar explanations and lesson content
Dialect and culture: Modern Standard Arabic alongside regional dialects

Translators, interpreters, teachers and bilingual professionals with experience across Modern Standard Arabic and regional dialects (Gulf, Iraqi, Levantine) are especially welcome.

Advantages Of Contracting With Us

You'll be able to choose which projects you want to work on and when
You work on your own schedule, on your own computer, from the comfort of your own home
Projects are paid hourly starting at $25–$40+/hr, with bonus rates available on some projects

Qualifications

Native or near-native fluency in Arabic and English
Strong command of grammar, style, tone and register in both languages
Detail-oriented, with the ability to explain your judgments clearly in writing
Experience in translation, interpretation, teaching, editing or bilingual professional work is a plus
A current, in-progress or completed Bachelor's degree is preferred but not required

Note

Payment is made via PayPal. We will never ask for any money from you. PayPal will handle any currency conversions from USD. Only applicants in Saudi Arabia, Iraq, and the United Arab Emirates will be considered for this role. This is an independent contractor position.

About The Role

We're looking for a hands-on AI Lead to join one of our clients, a growing technology company, and lead its AI strategy and delivery. You'll manage and mentor a small team of engineers and data scientists, working closely with business and technology stakeholders to turn business needs into practical AI solutions with measurable results.

What you'll do

Define the AI strategy, roadmap and priorities with business and technology leadership, aligning initiatives with business objectives.
Lead and mentor ML engineers and data scientists, setting clear goals, reviewing technical work and supporting team development.
Assess business problems and prioritise AI use cases based on value, feasibility, data readiness and implementation effort.
Own end-to-end AI delivery, from discovery and experimentation through development, deployment and ongoing monitoring.
Contribute directly to solution architecture, development and code reviews, establishing clear engineering and documentation standards.
Build applications using LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and generative AI, selecting traditional machine learning or simpler approaches where appropriate.
Collaborate with data engineering teams to ensure reliable data pipelines and suitable data quality for training, evaluation and production use.
Establish MLOps practices for experiment tracking, versioning, testing, deployment, monitoring and retraining where needed.
Define evaluation criteria and track model quality, business impact, latency and operating costs.
Evaluate generative AI applications for accuracy, hallucinations, safety and reliability before release and throughout production use.
Partner with legal, security and compliance teams to address applicable PDPL, data governance and data residency requirements.
Evaluate vendors, tools and platforms, making clear build-versus-buy recommendations.
Communicate progress, results, risks and investment needs to senior stakeholders in clear business terms.


What you bring

7+ years of experience in data science, machine learning or AI engineering, including at least 3 years managing and mentoring technical teams.
A proven track record of deploying and maintaining AI solutions in production, beyond proofs of concept.
Strong Python programming skills and experience with frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow or scikit-learn.
Hands-on experience building LLM applications, including RAG, prompt engineering and evaluation methods.
Experience with vector search technologies such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus or pgvector.
Experience designing AI architectures and integrating models into business applications through APIs and services.
Experience with at least one major cloud platform: AWS, Azure or GCP.
Practical experience with MLOps tools or platforms such as MLflow, Kubeflow, Amazon SageMaker or Azure Machine Learning.
Familiarity with Docker, Git and CI/CD pipelines for testing, packaging and deploying AI applications.
Strong understanding of data quality, model evaluation and the trade-offs between performance, reliability, cost and speed.
Ability to translate business needs into technical priorities and make informed delivery decisions.
Awareness of privacy, security and responsible AI considerations across the development lifecycle.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills in English. Arabic is an advantage.


Nice to have

Familiarity with LLM application frameworks such as LangChain or LlamaIndex, and tools for evaluating and monitoring LLM applications.
Experience with Hugging Face Transformers and adapting pretrained models to specific use cases.
Experience deploying and managing AI workloads on Kubernetes.

Account Management & Client Relationships

Conduct regular business reviews with clients to assess satisfaction, identify challenges, and uncover growth opportunities.

Develop and manage a healthy sales pipeline, accurately forecasting revenue and closing deals in line with targets.
Lead commercial negotiations, proposal development, and contract renewals in coordination with legal and finance teams.
Collaborate with pre-sales, technical, and delivery teams to craft compelling solution proposals tailored to client needs.

Work closely with technical teams to ensure proposed solutions are feasible, relevant, and aligned with client environments.
Stakeholder & Partner Collaboration
Collaborate with internal teams including delivery, product, marketing, and leadership to ensure seamless client experience.
Coordinate with technology partners and vendors (e.g., hyperscalers, cybersecurity OEMs) to co-develop and position joint offerings.
Represent the organization at industry events, conferences, and client engagements to strengthen brand presence and relationships.

Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of account activity, pipeline, and opportunities within the CRM system.
Provide regular sales forecasts, account updates, and market intelligence reports to senior leadership.
Track and report on account health metrics, revenue performance, and client satisfaction indicators.

Required Qualifications
Education
Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
Master's degree or MBA is an advantage.
Experience
5–10 years of experience in account management, sales, or business development within the technology sector.
Demonstrated experience selling or managing accounts in at least two of the three domains: AI, cloud, or cybersecurity.
Proven track record of meeting and exceeding revenue targets and growing strategic accounts.
Experience engaging with C-suite and senior executive stakeholders in enterprise environments.
Prior experience working with government, financial services, energy, or telecommunications clients is highly desirable.
Certifications
Cloud certifications (AWS, Azure, GCP) – preferred.
Cybersecurity certifications (CISSP, CISM, CompTIA Security+) – advantageous.
Sales certifications (Sandler, MEDDIC, Challenger) – a plus.

Ensure deployments are production-ready and transferable to customers, while shaping the platform roadmap and technical partnerships.
ai_requirements_summary: Candidates need at least six years of engineering experience, including leading teams that deliver production systems, and a record of taking products or platforms from inception to scaled use. They should have hands-on AI expertise and strong systems and enterprise-delivery experience; a PhD, GCC experience, Arabic or multimodal AI, open-weight model experience, and partner leadership are advantages.
description_text:
The Role: Leading Applied AI

Reporting to the Managing Director, you own Echelon’s applied AI engineering: the team, the technology and the technical quality of everything we deploy. You own the customer and build what is deployed against their most critical workflows, running every engagement as one team with the Head of AI Transformation.

Technical direction: Define the technical direction of every engagement: architecture, model and partner choices, and the build, partner or buy decisions behind them. 
Build the organisation: Hire and lead forward deployed engineers and their leads; design pods sized to signed demand, the hiring bar, the career paths and an engineering culture people want to join, with a deliberate pipeline of engineering talent in the region. 
Answer for delivery: Own the technical quality of every deployment from prototype to production, and sign off scope, architecture and technical risk before Echelon commits to a customer. Stay close enough to live systems to review designs, unblock critical issues and lead incident reviews. 
Support the sale: Be the senior technical counterpart in strategic pursuits: architecture, security and data-residency reviews, demos and solution design with customer CIOs and CISOs. Shape how engagements are scoped and priced. 
Set the standards: Set how Echelon builds, secures and operates AI systems, with the security and data baseline every deployment meets, aligned with data-protection and security regulations, and hold delivery partners to it. 
Transfer capability: Make sure every deployment leaves the customer able to run it: documentation, evaluations, monitoring, training and a clean handover. 
Shape the platform: Work with the platform lead to shape Echelon’s platform roadmap and its evolution over time, bringing repeated delivery patterns and customer needs back from the field. 
Shape the ecosystem: Lead the technical relationship with technology partners and model providers across Echelon’s engagements. 

Where We Align

AI and Technology First

Leadership record: You have 6+ years in engineering, including building and leading teams that ship production systems, as a senior leader in an AI company, a forward deployed business, or as a technical founder. 
Builder’s record: You have taken a product or platform from zero to real users at scale, and know the difference between a demo and a system an enterprise depends on. 
AI-native depth: Hands-on with LLMs, agent frameworks, MCP, retrieval and evaluation, with a clear view of how to make AI systems observable, safe and reliable at scale. You still go hands-on when it matters. 
Systems at scale: Command of distributed systems, data engineering, and cloud and on-premise infrastructure under strict data residency and security constraints. 
Enterprise delivery: You have led complex deployments for large enterprises or government, including technical pre-sales, scoping and the commercial trade-offs behind them. 
Executive credibility: Customer technology leaders, partners and investors trust your judgement, and you can explain a trade-off to an engineer and to a board on the same day. 

Strong Advantage

Academic depth: A PhD in AI, Machine Learning or Computer Science. 
Regional experience: Delivery in Saudi Arabia or the GCC, ideally in the public sector or regulated industries, with working knowledge of PDPL, NCA and SDAIA frameworks. 
Arabic & multimodal: Experience building Arabic NLP, speech or multimodal systems. Arabic language is a plus. 
Open-weight models: Fine-tuning, post-training or serving open-weight models on private or on-premise infrastructure. 
Partnerships: Experience leading technical relationships with model providers, cloud providers or technology partners. 

Our Values

Customer first: You measure your work by customer outcomes, and prioritise accordingly. 
Ownership mentality: You own outcomes end to end. When something breaks or stalls, you treat it as yours to fix. 
Clear communicator: You explain complex systems simply, to operators and executives alike, and make the value of your work visible. 
Comfortable with ambiguity: You make progress with incomplete information, partial data and unfamiliar environments, and you enjoy solving problems where there is no structure yet. 
Long-term builder: You invest in Echelon’s long-term success, bringing field insight back into our strategy and operations. 
Builds others: You measure yourself by the engineers you develop and the capability you leave behind with customers. 

The Seat

Location: London, with regular time in Riyadh, or Riyadh
Reports to: The Managing Director
Travel: Regular time on customer sites across the region and with partners abroad. 
Package: A base salary, performance bonus, medical cover, and equity through the employee equity programme. Terms are shared at offer stage. 

How We Work

You start from the problem, not the tool. You meet an unclear brief or a broken environment with energy and a plan.

Curiosity: You learn how the work really happens on site and keep learning as the stack moves. 
Speed: You move from brief to a working system quickly and do not wait for perfect conditions. 
Rigour: You reproduce before you fix, test what you ship and can explain every choice. 
Confidence & humility: You challenge and accept challenge, and change your view on evidence, without ego. 
Autonomy: You decide with incomplete information and own it; from an outcome, you organise the work yourself. 
Resourcefulness: Missing access, partial data, an unfamiliar codebase: you find a way with what is available. 
Situational leadership: You lead when the moment calls for it, and follow when someone else has the better call. 
A force multiplier: Your reviews, patterns and documentation make the whole bench faster. 
AI-native depth: AI tools are part of how you write, review and debug code and how you run the organisation, and you have built something real with an LLM. 
Where you are: A senior engineering leader who stays close to the code: fluent in Python, TypeScript or similar, and able to review what ships

Identify, assess, monitor, treat, and escalate cybersecurity risks using practical risk analysis and scoring approaches.
Monitor compliance with applicable National Cybersecurity Authority requirements, regulatory obligations, internal policies, and recognized frameworks.
Develop, review, and maintain cybersecurity policies, standards, procedures, control documentation, records, and supporting evidence.
Support cybersecurity audits, assessments, regulatory-readiness activities, remediation plans, and closure of findings or control gaps.
Prepare reports and presentations on cybersecurity posture, risks, compliance status, and improvement priorities.
Collaborate with Cybersecurity, IT, business, risk, compliance, internal audit, consultants, and service providers to achieve effective GRC outcomes.
Promote secure practices, accountability, continuous improvement, and effective stakeholder communication across the organization.
Depending on seniority, coordinate GRC initiatives, resources, vendors, project risks, and team deliverables.

description_text:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for Business Owners – Freelance AI Trainer Project candidates based in Saudi Arabia.

Are you an independent business owner looking to put your real-world expertise to work in the development of artificial intelligence? This freelance opportunity allows experienced entrepreneurs and business operators to contribute directly to the evaluation and improvement of AI-powered commerce tools. You will test digital platforms, assess local search accuracy, and review how AI systems represent real businesses and their services. By sharing practical insights from your day-to-day operations, you will help make digital tools more accurate, relevant, and useful for local merchants. The project offers a flexible, remote working environment where your industry knowledge and analytical skills can make a meaningful impact. It is particularly suited to hands-on business owners who understand local markets and want to help shape the future of AI-driven commerce.

Accountabilities

Test digital merchant tools: Independently evaluate new platform features, digital storefront solutions, and AI-powered recommendations designed to support local business management and customer engagement. 
Audit business profiles and search results: Review AI-generated business descriptions, local search results, and mapping integrations to verify their accuracy against actual business operations. 
Provide structured feedback: Document detailed, actionable observations about usability, relevance, and the practical value of digital tools for local businesses. 
Identify inaccuracies and anomalies: Detect and report cases where AI systems misrepresent business categories, services, opening hours, or local market characteristics. 
Evaluate user experience: Assess digital workflows from a merchant's perspective, highlighting usability issues, friction points, and opportunities for improvement. 
Contribute industry expertise: Apply firsthand knowledge of business operations to benchmark AI performance and help improve the accuracy and reliability of digital commerce systems. 
Deliver independent assessments: Complete evaluations autonomously and provide clear, evidence-based feedback in accordance with project guidelines and deliverable requirements. 

Requirements

Business ownership or management experience: Demonstrable professional experience as an active owner, operator, or primary manager of a business in the food and beverage, hospitality and lodging, local services, or retail sectors. 
Verified Google Business Profile: Current ownership or active management of a verified Google Business Profile associated with your business is mandatory. 
Operational business knowledge: A strong understanding of day-to-day business activities, customer engagement, local search visibility, and digital storefront management. 
Analytical and communication skills: Ability to identify technical inaccuracies, explain user experience issues, and provide clear, structured, and actionable feedback. 
Attention to detail: A meticulous approach to reviewing business information, digital workflows, search results, and consumer-facing representations. 
Independent working style: Ability to manage assignments autonomously, follow evaluation guidelines, and deliver consistent, high-quality results remotely. 
Digital proficiency: Comfort using online platforms, business listings, mapping tools, and digital commerce technologies. 
Local market expertise: Familiarity with the specific needs, practices, and nuances of your business sector and geographic market. 
Equipment and connectivity: Access to a secure computer and reliable, high-speed internet connection to complete project assignments. 

Benefits

Competitive hourly compensation: Earn between $25 and $100 USD per hour, depending on your experience, expertise, and geographic location. The final rate may vary from the advertised range. 
Flexible freelance engagement: Work as an independent contractor, with flexibility to manage assignments alongside your existing business responsibilities. 
Fully remote work: Complete project tasks remotely without the need to commute to a physical office. 
Real-world impact: Help improve AI accuracy, local search representation, and digital tools used by merchants and consumers. 
Leverage your expertise: Apply your practical business knowledge to emerging AI technologies without needing to transition into a traditional technology role. 
Independent working environment: Evaluate tools and provide feedback autonomously, using your firsthand experience as a business owner or operator. 
Contractor arrangement: This is a freelance engagement. Company-sponsored benefits, including health insurance and paid time off, are not provided. Contractors are responsible for supplying their own equipment and internet connection. 

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Product Concept Designer & Interior Stylist – Home Décor (Part-/Full-time) based in Saudi Arabia.

In this fully remote role, you will combine creative vision, interior design expertise, and advanced AI image-generation skills to develop distinctive, commercially promising home décor products. A key part of your work will involve creating photorealistic interior scenes that showcase products with accurate materials, textures, colors, and proportions. You will collaborate with designers to refine concepts and prepare product visuals for e-commerce launches. By balancing aesthetics with commercial potential, you will help shape an attractive product portfolio for a premium home décor brand serving online customers. This long-term freelance opportunity offers the flexibility to work part-time or full-time while contributing directly to product innovation and digital merchandising. It is ideal for a visually driven creative professional who understands how to turn inspiring design ideas into products customers want to buy.

Accountabilities

Product concept development: Research interior design trends, competitor offerings, and customer preferences to identify new home décor opportunities and develop original, commercially viable product concepts.
AI-powered concept visualization: Use advanced generative AI tools to explore, visualize, and refine new physical product ideas, translating creative concepts into compelling visual representations.
Interior styling and scene creation: Place existing and proposed products into realistic, aesthetically cohesive AI-generated interiors that reflect different design styles, including Japandi, organic modern, and coastal interiors.
Photorealistic product imagery: Produce high-quality lifestyle and product visuals for e-commerce websites, ensuring generated images accurately represent the original products' shapes, proportions, materials, colors, and textures.
Visual quality and consistency: Maintain high standards of realism, composition, lighting, and styling across all creative outputs, ensuring that product details remain faithful to the intended designs.
Trend research and opportunity identification: Monitor emerging interior styles, materials, product categories, and customer preferences to uncover opportunities for new product development and commercial growth.
Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with designers and relevant team members to refine concepts, incorporate feedback, and prepare product designs and visual assets for launch.
Commercial evaluation: Assess the market appeal and potential sales value of proposed products, balancing aesthetic originality with customer demand and commercial objectives.
E-commerce content development: Create visually engaging product and lifestyle imagery that strengthens online merchandising, communicates product value, and supports customer purchasing decisions.
Creative workflow management: Organize multiple projects, manage deadlines, maintain clear communication, and deliver consistent, high-quality outputs in a fully remote working environment.
Product feasibility awareness: Consider practical manufacturing requirements, material limitations, production constraints, and shipping considerations when developing physical product concepts.

Requirements

Visual design and aesthetic expertise: Excellent visual taste and a strong understanding of interior design, styling, color theory, materials, textures, proportions, and composition.
Advanced AI image-generation skills: Demonstrated proficiency with generative AI tools such as Nano Banana, Flux, Adobe Firefly, Midjourney, or comparable platforms.
Photorealistic image creation: Proven ability to generate convincing interior scenes and product imagery while preserving accurate product characteristics, including shape, material, color, texture, and proportions.
Creative concept development: Strong imagination and the ability to translate market insights, design inspiration, and customer preferences into original, visually appealing, and commercially promising physical products.
Relevant portfolio: A portfolio demonstrating high-quality interior visuals, AI-generated imagery, product concepts, home décor projects, or other closely related creative work.
Project management and organization: Strong organizational skills, reliability, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple creative assignments while meeting deadlines.
English proficiency: Fluent English communication skills for collaborating with the team, discussing concepts, understanding feedback, and documenting creative decisions.
Commercial awareness: An understanding of how visual design, product differentiation, and customer preferences influence purchasing decisions in e-commerce.

Strongly Preferred

Professional experience in home décor, interior styling, furniture, or lifestyle products.
Experience developing concepts for physical products from initial inspiration through visual refinement.
Familiarity with US interior design trends, home décor preferences, and target customer expectations.
Experience producing product photography alternatives, lifestyle visuals, or marketing imagery for e-commerce websites.

Requirements

Expert-level AI video generation: Demonstrated expertise in creating cinematic, high-quality videos with generative AI tools, with the ability to produce professional advertising content rather than basic AI-generated clips.
Generative AI tool proficiency: Hands-on experience with platforms such as Higgsfield Cinema Studio, Google Veo, Kling, Runway, Sora, Luma, Hailuo/MiniMax, Seedance, or comparable AI video-generation tools.

Video editing and finishing: Proficiency with professional editing and post-production tools such as Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, and Topaz for video enhancement and upscaling.

Strong creative portfolio: A portfolio showcasing high-quality cinematic AI-generated videos, commercials, product advertisements, or comparable professional creative work.
Creative storytelling: Ability to translate ideas into visually engaging narratives, create compelling opening hooks, and maintain audience interest throughout short-form advertising content.
Attention to detail: Strong visual judgment and the ability to maintain consistency in lighting, composition, motion, product appearance, and overall aesthetic quality.
Adaptability and experimentation: Willingness to test new tools, explore different creative approaches, and iterate quickly based on feedback and changing campaign requirements.
Independent project management: Strong organizational skills, reliability, and the ability to manage creative assignments independently while meeting deadlines in a remote environment.
Communication skills: Ability to understand creative briefs, communicate ideas clearly, incorporate feedback, and collaborate effectively with distributed teams.

Experience producing paid social advertisements for e-commerce or direct-to-consumer brands.
Understanding of performance marketing principles, including advertising hooks, pacing, audience engagement, creative formats, and conversion-focused storytelling.
Experience creating product-focused advertising for categories such as home décor, handcrafted art, jewelry, or other consumer lifestyle products.
Familiarity with adapting video assets for different advertising placements, aspect ratios, and platform requirements.

Experience developing advertising concepts and storylines from an initial brief.
Knowledge of creative testing strategies and how variations in visual storytelling can influence advertising performance.
Experience combining AI-generated footage, images, voiceovers, music, and sound effects into cohesive commercial productions.
Familiarity with emerging generative AI workflows and techniques for improving creative production speed and consistency.

description_text:
About Us : 
DirectFN is a leading Capital Market Industry (CMI) Financial Technology software and Content provider, company (now owned by Saudi Tadawul Group / WAMID) specializes in providing brokerage, asset, and custody management solutions, along with market information screens – as productized services. Our innovative products, services, and solutions empower both financial institutions and individuals to optimize their operations and enhance client satisfaction 

. JOB SUMMARY
The Cybersecurity, Risk and Resilience Manager at DirectFN is responsible for managing and executing the organization's cybersecurity governance, enterprise risk management, and business continuity programs. This role ensures that DirectFN adheres to relevant cybersecurity frameworks, regulatory standards, and risk management policies — protecting the integrity, availability, and confidentiality of DirectFN's systems, financial data platforms, and client-facing services. The Manager works closely with IT, technology, legal, and compliance teams, and reports directly to the COO, overseeing a cybersecurity specialist and contributing to the operational resilience of a leading fintech company in the Saudi capital markets ecosystem.
II. Key Responsibilities:
1. Cybersecurity Governance
• Collaborate with IT and technology teams to ensure alignment with cybersecurity frameworks including ISO 27001, NIST, and SAMA Cybersecurity Framework (CSF).
• Oversee cybersecurity policy development, maintenance, and enforcement across the organization.
• Conduct and coordinate risk assessments, vulnerability management activities, and incident response planning.
• Engage, manage, and monitor third-party vendors for cybersecurity assessments and timely remediation of identified risks.
• Monitor third-party vendor compliance with DirectFN's cybersecurity standards and contractual security obligations.
2. Enterprise Risk Management
• Operate the end-to-end enterprise risk program — identifying, assessing (likelihood and impact), treating, and monitoring risks across all business functions.
• Maintain a living risk register, applying consistent and practical scoring methodologies aligned with organizational risk appetite and tolerances.
• Conduct quarterly risk reviews with relevant business units and provide updated risk reporting to senior leadership.
• Map identified risks to controls drawn from ISO 27001 or equivalent control frameworks to ensure a robust control environment.
• Coordinate internal audits, manage corrective action plans, and prepare for external audits including ISO 27001 and SOC 2.
• Develop and maintain Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) and executive risk dashboards for leadership reporting.
• Liaise on cyber insurance underwriting data requirements and support the inclusion of risk clauses in customer and supplier contracts.
3. Business Continuity & Operational Resilience
• Lead the development, maintenance, and periodic testing of Business Continuity Plans (BCP) across DirectFN's critical business functions.
• Conduct Business Impact Assessments (BIA) and risk analyses to identify critical dependencies, recovery time objectives, and resilience gaps.
• Coordinate cross-functional continuity exercises and drills to validate the effectiveness of continuity strategies.
• Ensure DirectFN's operational resilience practices comply with relevant regulatory mandates, including SAMA and NCA requirements.
4. Compliance & Regulatory Management
• Maintain current knowledge of applicable regulatory frameworks including SAMA, NCA, GDPR, and ISO 27001, and ensure DirectFN's practices remain compliant.
• Support internal and external compliance reviews, audits, and regulatory submissions related to cybersecurity and risk.
• Provide guidance to business units on regulatory obligations and the implementation of required controls.
5. Incident & Breach Management
• Manage the cybersecurity incident response process — from detection and containment through investigation, remediation, and post-incident review.
• Maintain incident response plans, playbooks, and communication protocols for various breach and disruption scenarios.
• Coordinate with legal, communications, and senior leadership in the event of a material cybersecurity incident or data breach.
6. Team Oversight & Stakeholder Engagement
• Provide day-to-day direction and oversight to the Cybersecurity Specialist, ensuring effective execution of security operations and monitoring activities.
• Engage cross-functionally with IT, engineering, product, legal, and operations teams to embed security and risk awareness across the organization.
• Prepare and present cybersecurity and risk management reports to the COO and relevant leadership stakeholders.
III. Qualifications & Requirements:
○ Education: Bachelor's degree in IT Security, Information Systems, Finance, Law, or a related field; Master's degree preferred.
○ Experience: Minimum 7 years of experience in cybersecurity governance, IT risk management, or compliance within financial services or fintech.
○ Strong understanding of regulatory frameworks including SAMA CSF, NCA ECC, ISO 27001, NIST, and GDPR.
○ Proven experience managing enterprise risk programs, conducting risk assessments, and maintaining risk registers.
○ Hands-on experience with business continuity planning, BIA, and operational resilience frameworks.
○ Excellent analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
○ Fluent in English (spoken and written); Arabic is an advantage.
IV. Prefer to Have:
○ Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRCM, CCEP, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, or ISO 22301.
○ Experience working within Saudi Arabia's regulatory environment, particularly with SAMA and NCA cybersecurity requirements.
○ Familiarity with SOC 2 audit preparation and cyber insurance underwriting processes.
V. Core Skills:
○ Cybersecurity Governance: Deep knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks, policy development, and risk-based security management.
○ Risk Management: Structured, practical approach to enterprise risk identification, assessment, and mitigation.
○ Regulatory Awareness: Current and comprehensive understanding of cybersecurity and operational compliance obligations in the KSA and GCC.
○ Incident Management: Composed and methodical in managing security incidents, breaches, and business disruptions.
○ Stakeholder Communication: Able to translate technical risk concepts into clear, actionable insights for non-technical leadership.
○ Ethical Judgment: Maintains high standards of integrity and confidentiality in all risk and security activities.
VI. Key Result Areas (KRAs):
○ Regulatory Compliance: DirectFN's cybersecurity and risk practices consistently meeting SAMA, NCA, and relevant international standards.
○ Risk Posture: A well-maintained, up-to-date risk register with active treatment plans and clear ownership across the organization.
○ Incident Readiness: Tested, documented incident response and business continuity plans that enable rapid and effective response to disruptions.
○ Audit Readiness: Successful internal and external audits with minimal findings and timely closure of corrective actions.
Organizational Awareness: Improved security and risk awareness across DirectFN through governance, training, and cross-functional engagement

description_text:
Position Summary
This is a fully remote, hourly contractor role supporting AI data and language projects on a project-based, flexible hour basis. Project scopes vary and may include:
Data annotation: labeling, classifying, and structuring documents, tables, and other content to support AI training datasets.
LLM evaluation: reviewing AI-generated responses for accuracy, reasoning quality, coherence, and cultural/linguistic appropriateness.
Content generation: writing high-quality prompts and model responses to guide AI learning across diverse topics.
Localization QA: ensuring terminology, tone, cultural nuance, and locale-specific details (units, references, names, dates) are consistently accurate across outputs.

You will apply senior-level Arabic localization and translation judgment alongside minimum C1 English proficiency to ensure terminology, tone, and cultural nuance are consistently accurate across use cases.
Profile Requirements
Bachelor's degree or higher in Translation, Linguistics, Localization, Communications, or a related field.
Native or near-native Arabic proficiency with strong writing and editing skills across Modern Standard Arabic and at least one dialect.
Minimum C1 English proficiency (reading/writing) for interpreting prompts, source materials, and evaluation guidelines.
Excellent editorial judgment in register, tone, punctuation, inclusivity, and cultural nuance, with extreme attention to detail.
Ability to identify meaning drift, ambiguity, locale inconsistencies, and subtle errors, and to explain corrections clearly in writing.
Ability to rigorously fact-check localized content (units, references, names, dates) using reliable sources and consistent reasoning.
Ability to identify reasoning gaps, methodological errors, and unclear explanations even when language is fluent.
Reliable, self-directed, and able to deliver consistent quality with clear communication and responsiveness across time zones.

Preferred Experience
Professional localization or translation experience.
Familiarity with MQM/LQA concepts (severity, category, and root-cause thinking) for consistent quality decisions.
Proficiency with CAT tools and QA workflows (translation memory, termbases, automated checks).
Previous experience with AI data training, annotation, or evaluation.

This position represents a foundational hire in building the organization’s internal software engineering capability, with the objective of progressively transitioning from vendor-led development to internally owned and delivered digital products.

description_text:
LAKEORA is a Riyadh-based data and AI advisory firm and a pure-play Databricks partner. We build the governed data platforms that Saudi enterprises run their decisions on, going deep on one platform rather than wide across many, with governance designed in from the start. We are early-stage, flat, and deliberately small. You work directly with customers, own the architecture you design, and see it reach production. We like engineers who are direct, curious, and would rather get something right than get it agreed.

What are we looking for?

We’re looking for a Data and AI Governance Specialist who supports governance end to end: framework design, data quality, AI risk, and national index readiness (NDI/NAII) that turns compliance into a client deliverable, not a checkbox.

At LAKEORA, this role is client-facing by design. You’ll work directly with client stakeholders, support data and AI governance delivery, and help translate findings into recommendations that are tangible for both technical and business audiences. Lean team, high visibility, real impact.

Key Responsibilities

Data Governance

Support clients in designing and documenting data governance frameworks: ownership models, stewardship roles, policies, and standards
Support data quality initiatives: profiling, defining quality rules, monitoring, and remediation tracking
Support data cataloging, metadata management, and lineage documentation across client environments
Help translate client business requirements into governance scope, deliverables, and effort estimates

AI Governance

Support clients in designing AI governance frameworks: model inventory, risk-tiering, approval workflows, and documentation standards
Help assess client AI systems against responsible AI principles: explainability, auditability, bias, and risk controls
Map client data and AI practices against global frameworks to benchmark maturity

National Index Readiness (NDI / NAII)

Run client readiness assessments against the National Data Index (NDI) and National AI Index (NAII) scoring criteria, identifying gaps between current practice and index requirements
Compile and organize the evidence, documentation, and artifacts clients need to demonstrate compliance for index submissions
Build remediation roadmaps that close index gaps in priority order, sequenced against client timelines and resourcing
Track client progress against NDI/NAII benchmarks across engagement milestones and report status to stakeholders
Stay current on updates to NDI/NAII methodology and criteria, and translate changes into updated client guidance

Client Delivery

Participate in discovery sessions with prospective and existing clients, documenting findings and shaping governance approaches
Coordinate with client enterprise architecture and IT teams to ensure governance work aligns with their broader data and AI strategy
Build working relationships with client business stakeholders and communicate findings in business-impact terms
Support the establishment and operation of client data and AI governance offices

Qualifications

Required:

Bachelor’s degree in IT, Data Management, or a related field
3+ years of experience in data governance and/or AI governance
Strong awareness of local data protection, data management, and AI regulatory frameworks in the Kingdom, including national data and AI indexes such as NDI and NAII
Solid understanding of data standards, policies, procedures, and data quality frameworks
Strong communication skills with the ability to engage both technical and business stakeholders confidently
Fluency in Arabic and English

Preferred:

Direct experience supporting a National Data Index (NDI) or National AI Index (NAII) readiness or submission process
DAMA certification
Familiarity with AI governance/risk frameworks or platforms
Consulting or client-facing delivery experience
Exposure to data governance tooling 
Saudi National

description_text:
Responsibilities
About the team:
The Cybersecurity team owns security for all services offered by Volcano Engine & BytePlus which is a cloud service provider owned by ByteDance, including IaaS, PaaS and SaaS. Join our forward-thinking security team dedicated to securing our cloud infrastructure with cutting-edge technologies and best practices. You will have the opportunity to design and implement robust security solutions for our cloud environments, ensuring the protection of sensitive data and the resilience of our systems.

The Director of Information Security is responsible for the overall cybersecurity posture of the organization and for ensuring compliance with applicable cybersecurity laws, regulations, and regulatory frameworks, including the National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA) Essential Cybersecurity Controls (ECC) within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA).

This role will provide independent executive leadership and oversight across cybersecurity governance, risk management, and security operations. The role requires a pragmatic, business-oriented leader with strong expertise in cybersecurity, cloud security, and modern technology environments, capable of ensuring that cybersecurity risks are identified, managed, and reported in alignment with the organization's risk appetite and regulatory expectations.

You’ll collaborate closely with senior executives. This role offers the opportunity to shape strategic outcomes, reduce risk exposure, and drive secure innovation across complex, interconnected ecosystems.

Responsibilities:
Cybersecurity Governance & Leadership:
- Establish and maintain enterprise-wide cybersecurity governance in line with SAMA CSF and NCA ECC requirements.
- Ensure clear ownership, accountability, and segregation of duties across cybersecurity functions.
- Advise executive management on cybersecurity risks, threats, and control effectiveness.
- Ensure cybersecurity considerations are embedded into corporate governance and enterprise risk management.

Cybersecurity Risk Management & Compliance:
- Own and oversee the cybersecurity risk management framework.
- Ensure continuous compliance with applicable regulations and industry good practices.
- Ensure timely remediation of audit findings and regulatory observations.
- Act as the primary point of accountability for cybersecurity matters with regulators.

Security Operations & Technology Oversight:
- Oversee cybersecurity operations including monitoring, detection, vulnerability management, IAM, and incident response.
- Ensure effective prevention, detection, response, and recovery capabilities.
- Govern the selection and operation of cybersecurity technologies.
- Ensure security by design across infrastructure, applications, cloud, and data platforms.

Incident Management & Cyber Resilience:
- Ensure effective incident response and cyber crisis management.
- Lead executive coordination during material cybersecurity incidents.
- Ensure alignment with business continuity and disaster recovery.
- Oversee post-incident reviews.

About the Role

Own data and AI reference architecture and engineering standards across Azure and Google Cloud (GCP)
Lead lakehouse and data platform delivery using Databricks, Delta Lake, and enterprise data lake patterns
Design and govern enterprise data pipelines: data ingestion, ETL/ELT, batch/stream processing, and orchestration

Manage and coach data engineering and ML engineering teams; set objectives, build capability, and drive delivery excellence
Manage vendors, partners, and cloud providers; control cost, performance, and SLAs

description_text:
About Lucidya

Lucidya builds an operating system for Agentic customer experience. Our flagship product line is an agentic platform (Agent Studio) where customers build and run AI agents that resolve real customer experience issues across text and voice channels, in Arabic and English.

Role Summary

The AI Tech Lead is the senior hands-on engineer accountable for the quality, reliability and technical direction of the AI layer of our agentic platform. You will set the technical bar for a team of AI engineers who each own an area, and you will write production code yourself. You will need to wear 2 hats, one is the AI hat and the other is leadership

Key Responsibilities

Technical direction

Own and be accountable for the AI architecture and harness: model selection, prompting patterns, retrieval design, guardrails and voice pipeline
Make and document technical decisions with clear rationale

Quality, evaluation and reliability

Define the evaluation standard and move key work from experimentation to production
Introduce leading testing frameworks for Agentic development 
Ensure production monitoring and online evals catch quality drops, hallucinations and latency spikes before customers report them

Team leadership and engineering practices

Lead the AI team in designing, developing, and delivering our Agentic Platform
Mentor AI engineers, raise the technical bar through pairing and feedback, and contribute to hiring

Hands-on delivery

Lead debugging of critical production incidents involving AI behaviour
Manage the building of prototypes/experiments to validate new capabilities (new models, agent patterns, voice features) before the team commits to them

Cross-functional partnership

Work with Product to turn customer use cases into technical requirements
Work with Engineering on shared platform work: tool calling, workflows, deployment and scaling

Mindset and Behaviors

Ownership: takes outcomes end to end, including gaps between teams, and follows through without being asked
Trade-off judgement: grounds decisions in business needs and can explain the trade-offs between quality, speed and cost
Constructive challenge: comfortable questioning existing approaches and proposing better ones
Team player: shares credit, helps teammates succeed, and puts team goals ahead of individual wins
Creativity and innovation: solve complex challenges with 'out-of-box' thinking and be a champion for innovation 

Requirements

Experience: 7+ years in software or ML engineering, including 2+ years building LLM-based applications in production. Not just building AI point solutions, AI platform level experience is required
Technical leadership: has led a team of 3+ AI engineers/scientist technically (design reviews, standards, mentoring)
LLM application engineering: deep hands-on experience with prompting, structured outputs, guardrails, agent patterns/harness development (planning, tool use, multi-step reasoning)
Ability to work in ambiguous settings: can bring clarity and structure to complex situations
Evaluation: has built LLM evaluation pipelines (golden datasets, LLM-as-judge, regression suites) and used them to gate releases
Production engineering: strong Python; experience with APIs, cloud deployment, observability and debugging distributed systems
Communication: fluent written and spoken English; able to write clear design docs and decision records

Nice-to-have Qualifications

Arabic NLP: experience with Arabic and its dialects, especially Gulf Arabic, in LLM or speech systems
Voice AI: experience with ASR, TTS and real-time voice agents, including latency optimisation
Production monitoring for LLMs: hands-on use of tracing and online eval tools (for example Langfuse, Arize or similar)
Model adaptation: fine-tuning or distilling open-weight models, and serving them cost-effectively

description_text:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD. 

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) for AI and GenAI Inference Optimization

About The Role

We are seeking a Member of Technical Staff to join our Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team. In this customer-facing role, you will work directly with strategic partners and customers as part of the FDE team to enable, optimize, and deploy state-of-the-art GenAI inference workloads on AMD data center CPUs and GPUs (Instinct™ family). You will bridge the gap between cutting-edge AI models and AMD hardware, driving competitive performance across the full inference stack.

Responsibilities

Partner with customers as part of the FDE team to enable and optimize large language models (LLMs) and multimodal models on AMD Instinct GPUs, meeting committed performance and accuracy targets.
Optimize GenAI inference pipelines on vLLM and SGLang, including PD disaggregation, expert parallelism (EP/wide-EP), tensor/data parallelism, speculative decoding, and KV cache management.
Develop and tune low-level GPU kernels (Triton, HIP, composable kernels) for attention, MoE, GEMM, quantization, and normalization operations.
Profile end-to-end workloads, identify bottlenecks across GPU/CPU boundaries, and deliver measurable throughput and latency improvements versus competitive targets.
Enable advanced data types and techniques (FP8, MXFP4, sparse attention) with a focus on both performance and numerical accuracy.
Debug complex runtime, stability, and accuracy issues in production environments; partner with core engineering teams to identify root causes and contribute fixes.
Contribute optimizations back to open-source frameworks (vLLM, SGLang, ATOM, AITER) and internal libraries; document best practices and deliver production-ready artifacts to customers.
Leverage AI-assisted coding tools and agentic workflows to accelerate development, debugging, optimization, and code review across the inference stack.


What You'll Bring

BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, along with 8+ years of relevant experience.
Solid expertise in GPU architecture and performance optimization, including hands-on experience with AMD ROCm (or CUDA) and GPU kernel development.
Strong proficiency in Python and C++, with experience developing and optimizing kernels using Triton, HIP, or CUDA.
Experience with AI-assisted coding and agentic development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, or equivalent) to enhance productivity in kernel development, large-scale codebase navigation, debugging, and framework integration.
Experience working with LLM inference frameworks (vLLM, SGLang, or equivalent) and serving optimization techniques.
Solid understanding of transformer and MoE architectures, quantization, and distributed inference strategies (TP, DP, EP, and related parallelism techniques).
Proficiency with profiling and debugging tools (e.g., rocProfiler, ROCdebug-agent).


Nice to Have

Experience optimizing frontier models (DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, MiniMax, GLM, etc.) in production environments.
Track record of contributing to open-source AI inference frameworks.
Experience integrating AI-driven automation into engineering workflows and developer tooling.
Strong customer-facing communication skills and the ability to manage technical deliverables against committed timelines.

description_text:
A Swissbit more you.

At Swissbit, you shape the future! Swissbit is the leading manufacturer of storage and security solutions for industrial, data networking and AI infrastructure applications. We are shaping the future of intelligent connectivity—from carrier networks to hyperscale data centers. We empower the digital and connected world by reliably storing and protecting data. For this - and many other exciting projects - we are looking for people who share our passion for creating impact together.

Because we get things done - and preferably today rather than tomorrow. We are there when a customer needs a solution. In doing so, we take leaps we have never made before - because we trust in our expertise. We say: yes, of course!

Your mission

We are looking for professionals passionate about next-generation connectivity and the technologies powering cloud, AI-infrastructure, telecom and enterprise infrastructures. As the Product Marketing & Go-to-Market Manager – AI-Infrastrucure, Networking & Enterprise Storage (m/f/d) you are leading and coordinating a cross-functional Business Segment Team that drives sustainable business growth, customer engagement and market share expansion. You effectively align Marketing, Sales and Product Management activities to identify market opportunities, define go-to-market strategies, enable customer success and achieve market share and design-win targets.

Do you enjoy bringing technology and business together? Can you explain complex topics in a simple way? Do you work with a strong business focus and are committed to driving success? Then read on - we are looking for exactly you!

Exciting tasks are waiting for you

Define and execute the growth strategy for the business segment Netcom & Enterprise Storage aligned with corporate business objectives.
Collaborate with Product Management to influence product roadmaps based on market requirements and competitive insights
Drive go-to-market initiatives and commercial campaigns to increase revenue, market share and customer adoption
Establish clear Business Segment objectives, KPIs and execution priorities while ensuring accountability across all functions
Ensure strong alignment between customer needs, product positioning, technical value propositions and sales activities
Monitor and analyze business performance, pipeline development, market dynamics and competitive activities
Act as the central point of leadership and decision coordination for the assigned market segment

Your profile

Successfully completed degree in marketing, business administration or engineering
Several years of experience in product/technical marketing, sales, business development within electrical engineering disciplines
Strong understanding of the systems and partner networks behind high-bandwidth, low-latency communications for the world’s most demanding networking and storage applications
Excellent communication and presentation skills
Experience in go-to-market strategies, campaign management and sales enablement
Entrepreneurial and customer oriented mindset
Very good German and/or English skills, written and spoken
Willingness to travel up to 30%

Benefits & Compensation

The opportunity to shape strategy, positioning and market direction with visible impact across the organization
A role that bridges technology, market trends, customer engagement and business strategy
Working with differentiated solutions rather than broadly commoditized products
Contributing to areas like AI infrastructure, edge systems, industrial IoT, cybersecurity and resilient data solutions
Freedom to introduce ideas, challenge assumptions and create new market opportunities
Health insurance 401(k) matching
Paid time off
Dental insurance
Paid holidays
Vision insurance
Remote or Hybrid work
The Total Compensation Package is between $120,000 – $180,000 per year, depending on experience, qualifications, and location

About Us

Swissbit AG is the leading European manufacturer of storage, security and embedded IoT solutions for demanding applications. Swissbit combines its unique competences in storage and embedded IoT technology with its advanced packaging know how. This expertise allows our customers to reliably store and protect data in industrial, NetCom, automotive, medical and fiscal applications as well as across the Internet of Things (IoT). Swissbit develops and manufactures real industrial storage and security products “Made in Germany” with long-term availability, high reliability and custom optimization.

Swissbit was founded in 2001 and has offices in Switzerland, Germany, USA, Japan and Taiwan. Swissbit owns the registered trademarks Swissbit and Hyperstone.

Please note: We are actively hiring for this position. However, due to the current regional situation in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, our hiring process may take longer than usual. We appreciate your patience and will keep you informed throughout the process.

Test Engineer – Servers (ISG)

Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia (Special Integrated Logistics Zone)

Department: Engineering

Experience: 2+ years preferred

Employment type: Full-time

About The Role

Before a server leaves our line, it has to prove it works. As a Test Engineer in Lenovo’s Infrastructure Solutions Group (ISG) in Riyadh, you’ll build and run the production testing that makes sure it does.

You’ll prepare, validate and improve the test processes, stations and configurations behind our server manufacturing at every stage: new product introduction (NPI), line qualification, pilot runs, ramp-up and mass production. When a unit fails, you’ll dig into the data and logs, find out why, and fix it, so testing stays stable and production keeps moving.

What You’ll Do

Set up, validate and maintain production test stations, test environments and equipment
Deploy test software and manage test code and configurations, including BIOS, BMC and firmware versions
Analyze test failures using test data, logs and on-site observation, and resolve issues through to closure
Support server configuration testing, including OS, RAID and network setup
Make sure test data uploads correctly to the MES for full traceability
Drive improvements in test stability, yield and efficiency
Work with Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering, suppliers and global Lenovo teams, and give hands-on support when urgent issues come up

What You’ll Bring

A bachelor’s degree or higher in Electrical, Electronic or Computer Engineering, Automation, Computer Science, IT or a related field
2+ years in server, PC or electronics manufacturing, test engineering or system validation (preferred)
A good understanding of production test processes, station setup, test equipment, logs and failure analysis
Familiarity with server hardware, BIOS/BMC/firmware, Windows Server and Linux, RAID and network troubleshooting
Good written and spoken English
Willingness to give hands-on support on the production floor during ramp-up

What We Offer

An international team with a high focus on Gender Diversity.
Employee Assistance Program, e.g., for psychological, legal financial consultancy
You are joining a company that prioritizes sustainable solutions like CO2 Offset, Asset Recovery Services, and the Lenovo Certified Refurbished portfolio.
Access to training for personal development - Internal E-learning Development Platform Available for Employees
Mentorship program

description_text:
We are looking for a skilled Network & Infrastructure Engineer to manage and maintain the organization's network infrastructure across HQ and dark store locations. The role is responsible for ensuring reliable LAN/WAN connectivity, secure VPN communications, CCTV surveillance systems, and physical access control solutions while maintaining high network availability, security, and operational efficiency.

Responsibilities

Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot LAN/WAN infrastructure across HQ and all store locations. 
Manage routing, switching, VLANs, firewall policies, and network performance to ensure maximum uptime. 
Deploy, configure, and support site-to-site and remote VPN connectivity between stores and HQ. 
Monitor and resolve network connectivity issues while ensuring secure encrypted communications. 
Install, configure, and maintain IP CCTV cameras, NVR systems, and remote surveillance platforms. 
Administer physical access control systems, including door controllers, access groups, and user permissions. 
Monitor network health and infrastructure performance using network monitoring tools. 
Maintain accurate network documentation, including network diagrams, IP address management, and configuration records. 
Collaborate with IT Support, Security, Facilities, and external contractors to deliver infrastructure projects and support business operations. 
Ensure compliance with IT security standards and infrastructure best practices


Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Network Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. 
Minimum 3 years of experience in network engineering within a multi-site environment. 
CCNA certification is required. 
Strong knowledge of routing, switching, VLANs, TCP/IP, and firewall administration. 
Hands-on experience with VPN technologies (IPSec and SSL VPN). 
Experience with IP surveillance systems such as Hikvision, Dahua, or Axis, including NVR administration. 
Knowledge of physical access control platforms such as HID Global, Suprema, or equivalent. 
Experience using network monitoring tools such as PRTG or Zabbix. 
Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills. 
Excellent communication skills and the ability to work across multiple locations and cross-functional teams. 
Willingness to travel to company sites as required

Test Engineer – Mobile Phones (MBG)

Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia (Special Integrated Logistics Zone)

Department: Engineering

Experience: 2+ years preferred

Employment type: Full-time

About The Role

Every phone that comes off our line has to be flashed, tested and proven ready for the customer. As a Test Engineer in Lenovo’s Mobile Business Group (MBG) in Riyadh, you’ll make sure that happens reliably, at speed and at scale.

You’ll prepare, validate and improve the production test processes, stations and configurations behind our phone manufacturing at every stage: new product introduction (NPI), line qualification, pilot runs, ramp-up and mass production. When a test fails or a station misbehaves, you’ll find the cause quickly and fix it. That protects product quality and keeps the line ready to run.

What You’ll Do

Set up, validate and maintain production test stations, test equipment and fixtures
Deploy test software and manage test code and configurations under change control
Support software flashing, functional testing, RF testing and other phone test stages on the line
Analyze test failures, logs and station abnormalities, and resolve software, equipment and connectivity issues
Make sure test data uploads correctly to the MES for full traceability
Follow corrective actions through to closure and drive improvements in yield and test efficiency
Work with Production, Quality, Engineering, suppliers and global Lenovo teams, and give hands-on support when urgent issues come up

What You’ll Bring

A bachelor’s degree or higher in Electronic, Electrical, Computer or Communication Engineering, Automation, Computer Science or a related field
2+ years in test engineering for mobile phone, consumer electronics or electronics manufacturing (preferred)
A good understanding of phone production testing: flashing, functional testing and RF testing
Good written and spoken English
Willingness to work on the production floor during ramp-up and mass production

An international team with a high focus on Gender Diversity.
Employee Assistance Program, e.g., for psychological, legal financial consultancy
You are joining a company that prioritizes sustainable solutions like CO2 Offset, Asset Recovery Services, and the Lenovo Certified Refurbished portfolio.

Mentorship program

description_text:
Job Description

The QA Engineer is responsible for designing and executing manual and automated tests to verify software functionality, performance, reliability, and usability. The role ensures that digital solutions meet defined quality standards and user expectations by identifying defects and quality issues early in the development lifecycle and supporting their timely resolution.

Key Responsibilities

Execute manual and automated test cases to validate software functionality, performance, reliability, and usability.
Design, maintain, and update test cases and test scenarios based on requirements and acceptance criteria.
Identify, document, track, and verify software defects, providing clear information to support timely resolution.
Review requirements and acceptance criteria to identify gaps, ambiguities, and potential quality issues early in the development lifecycle.
Contribute to test planning by identifying appropriate test scenarios, test data, and estimating testing efforts.
Perform functional, regression, integration, and other applicable testing to ensure delivered features meet defined quality standards and acceptance criteria.
Collaborate with developers, business analysts, product teams, and other stakeholders to clarify requirements and support the resolution of quality issues.
Maintain accurate test documentation and communicate testing progress, results, defects, and identified quality risks to relevant stakeholders.

Key Deliverables

Complete and accurate test cases and test scenarios aligned with requirements and acceptance criteria.
Documented test execution results with clear status, findings, and supporting evidence.
Complete and traceable defect reports, including reproduction steps, severity, supporting evidence, and relevant logs.
Verified defect fixes with documented retest and regression results.
Completed functional, regression, integration, and other assigned testing within planned timelines.
Updated test coverage through additional scenarios, edge cases, and identified requirement gaps.
Accurate and up-to-date test documentation ensuring traceability between requirements, test cases, defects, and results.
Clear test cycle status reports highlighting testing progress, defects, blockers, identified quality risks, and overall testing outcomes.

Job Requirements

Education, Certification & Years of experience

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related field
Professional certifications or licenses required or preferred for this role: Master's degree, ISTQB test certificates
Minimum number of years of relevant work experience required for this role: 2 to 4

Skills & Competencies

Problem Solving & Analytical Thinking: Ability to analyze software quality issues, identify root causes, and apply logical and structured approaches to problem resolution.
Attention to Detail: Ability to identify defects, inconsistencies, edge cases, and deviations from requirements and expected behavior.
Communication: Ability to communicate testing results, defects, quality risks, and technical information clearly and effectively to relevant stakeholders.
Quality Mindset: Commitment to maintaining high-quality standards and proactively identifying opportunities to improve software quality and user experience.
Adaptability & Learning Agility: Ability to learn and adapt to evolving technologies, testing tools, methodologies, and development practices.
Technical Aptitude: Ability to understand software systems, testing concepts, tools, and technologies relevant to quality assurance activities.
Planning & Prioritization: Ability to organize testing activities, manage priorities, and deliver assigned work within planned timelines.
Collaboration & Teamwork: Ability to work effectively with QA, development, product, business analysis, and other relevant teams throughout the software development lifecycle.
