Position Summary
We are seeking a highly motivated and skilled Senior HPC Systems Administrator to join the KAUST Supercomputing Laboratory (KSL). The successful candidate will be responsible for managing an HPC cluster of approximately 600 CPU and GPU nodes, HPC storage systems, InfiniBand and Ethernet networks, and day-to-day operational issues. The role provides broad support to researchers and end-users across computational science, engineering, big data analysis, and artificial intelligence/machine learning workloads.

Major Responsibilities – include but are not limited to - 

Provide timely and effective user support via telephone, walk-in, email, and ticketing system for all inquiry types while maintain high customer service standards.
Install, configure, and manage HPC subsystems including compute nodes, high-performance storage systems, InfiniBand, Ethernet, and configuration management tools (e.g., Ansible, Puppet).
Deploy and manage cluster management software, monitoring tools, and supporting services for operating HPC clusters.
Install and administer the Slurm workload manager, manage QOS policies, accounts, accounting, and related automation scripts (Python and C++).
Develop and maintain automation scripts in Bash and Python to streamline system administration tasks.
Deploy and manage container environments (Singularity/Apptainer, Docker) for HPC workloads.
Benchmark HPC system components like CPU, memory, InfiniBand, and storage periodically to ensure optimal performance and identify tuning opportunities across hardware, driver, and application layers.
Enforce security best practices including node hardening, kernel patching, and compliance across all systems.
Manage parallel file systems such as Lustre, GPFS, Weka, or Vast, including performance tuning and capacity planning.
Directly support research activities in computational science, engineering, data analysis, and AI/ML by working closely with faculty, researchers, collaboration partners, and industrial partners in collaboration with application support teams.
Develop software tools and utilities as needed to support research projects on cluster systems and subsystems.
Drive proof-of-concept projects and technology evaluations end-to-end and research industry best practices and advocate system enhancements.
Coordinate with vendors and third-party service providers to report and resolve issues in a timely manner.
Develop and maintain user documentation, standard operating procedures, and training materials in the internal wiki.
Stay at the forefront of HPC advancements through continuous learning, industry conferences, and professional collaboration, while driving benchmarking initiatives to inform future hardware procurement.

Competencies

Expertise in supporting users of computational science and engineering, data analysis, and artificial intelligence applications and libraries in different HPC environments.
Strong expertise in Linux system administration (RHEL, Rocky Linux, or CentOS) in large-scale HPC environments.
Proficiency with HPC applications and programming models (Fortran, C/C++, Python, MPI, OpenMP, CUDA, OpenACC).
Demonstrated track record of managing complex HPC systems, including parallel file systems, job schedulers, InfiniBand/Ethernet networks, and monitoring systems.
Experience with configuration management tools (Ansible, Puppet, or equivalent).
Familiarity with computational science, data analysis, and AI/ML applications and libraries used in HPC environments.
Knowledge of project management principles and practices.
Demonstrated ability to support research activities in a highly collaborative HPC environment.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
Proactively identifies and implements system improvements; takes initiative and sees tasks through to closure.
Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and deliver high-quality results within deadlines.
Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally with researchers, application teams, and vendors.
Effective in multi-cultural, international work environments.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, including the ability to prepare and deliver technical reports and presentations.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science/engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent

Experience
Experience requirement, minimum: 
Five years of experience supporting large scale computing platforms and related subsystems.
Experience troubleshooting complex hardware issues and documenting root cause analysis.
Experience managing parallel storage systems (Lustre, GPFS, Weka, Vast, or similar).
Experience benchmarking HPC system components (CPU, memory, InfiniBand, storage).
Experience administering workload managers/schedulers (Slurm, LSF, or PBS).
Strong Linux system administration experience (RHEL, Rocky Linux, or CentOS).

Ability to coordinate with researchers, application support teams, and vendors to resolve complex issues and drive them to closure.

Familiarity with Kubernetes and container orchestration platforms would be desirable

About The Role

Before a server leaves our line, it has to prove it works. As a Test Engineer in Lenovo’s Infrastructure Solutions Group (ISG) in Riyadh, you’ll build and run the production testing that makes sure it does.

You’ll prepare, validate and improve the test processes, stations and configurations behind our server manufacturing at every stage: new product introduction (NPI), line qualification, pilot runs, ramp-up and mass production. When a unit fails, you’ll dig into the data and logs, find out why, and fix it, so testing stays stable and production keeps moving.

Set up, validate and maintain production test stations, test environments and equipment
Deploy test software and manage test code and configurations, including BIOS, BMC and firmware versions

description_text:
About Lucid

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience.

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

Position Overview

The Sr Test Engineer, Dynamometer owns dynamometer test operations at AMP-2 —dynameter, efficiency mapping, and performance/durability validation. Joining a greenfield facility, this engineer builds dyno infrastructure from first commissioning through volume ramp to SOP. The role is accountable for dyno test integrity, correlation, and productivity. The role operates through disciplined change control, objective launch evidence, cross-functional problem solving.

Key Responsibilities

Dyno Operations & Test Cycles
Own dyno stations operations
Maintain dyno stations readiness and safety compliance

Performance & Efficiency Mapping

Own efficiency mapping across torque/speed operating envelope
Execute steady-state and transient performance validation

Torque, Speed & Power Measurement

Own torque transducer standards, correction factors, and correlation
Ensure speed and power measurement integrity

Test Cell Instrumentation

Own instrumentation for temperature, current, voltage, and position
Maintain calibration and traceability of test cell instruments

High-Speed Data Acquisition

Own DAQ standards, calibration, and sampling strategies
Ensure data integrity for validation and analytics

TPM & Autonomous Maintenance Support

Support TPM deployment across Autonomous Maintenance, Planned Maintenance, and Focused Improvement pillars
Contribute to equipment OEE improvement, MTBF/MTTR reduction, and predictive maintenance strategies
Leverage MES, IIoT, and historian analytics to identify and eliminate losses

HV Safety & Compliance

Enforce HV LOTO, HVIL continuity, and mandatory HV PPE for all work on or near EV Powertrain equipment
Comply with SASO, Saudi MOL, IEC 60204, and functional safety standards (ISO 13849 / IEC 62061)
Support HV emergency response including thermal runaway isolation and battery-related incident procedures
Achieve and maintain HV safety competency appropriate to scope of work

Launch Governance & Ramp-Up

Support AMP-2 Safe Launch activities, run-at-rate events, and capacity verification within scope
Contribute to Launch Readiness Reviews, Layered Process Audits, and Process Confirmation routines
Participate in QRQC / RCCA escalations during launch and ramp-up phases

Dynamometer Engineering & Test Integrity

Commission and sustain dyno controls, inverter/battery simulators, cooling, oil conditioning, torque/speed measurement, DAQ, safety systems and facility interfaces.
Develop automated test sequences and, where applicable, LabVIEW or equivalent softwares; manage recipes, configuration and software release.
Correlate torque, speed, power, temperature, voltage/current and efficiency results across cells using reference units and uncertainty analysis.
Own cell availability, preventive maintenance, instrumentation health, test throughput and safe response to HV, overspeed, thermal, fluid and rotating-equipment hazards.

Launch Governance, Change Control & Operational Readiness

Support FAT/SAT, commissioning, equipment acceptance, Safe Launch, run-at-rate and capacity verification with objective evidence and disciplined punch-list closure.
Control production, process, software and test changes through documented risk assessment, approvals, validation, revision history and rollback or containment planning.
Participate in readiness reviews, Layered Process Audits, Process Confirmation and QRQC/RCCA; close assigned actions with verified effectiveness.

Safety, Quality, Data Integrity & Compliance

Apply role-specific HV LOTO/HVIL, machine safety, stored-energy isolation, electrical safe-work and PPE requirements; never bypass safety devices or product protections.
Protect product genealogy, calibrated-tool status, test/measurement integrity, document control and audit-ready objective evidence.
Comply with applicable AMP-2, SASO, Saudi labor/EHS, IATF 16949, IEC 60204 and functional-safety requirements within assigned scope.

Saudization, Capability Transfer & Collaboration

Build Saudi national capability through structured OJT, ILU/skills matrices, practical assessment, certification, cross-training and documented knowledge transfer.
Create technical standards, troubleshooting guides and training material; support interviews and KSA university/TVTC engagement where requested.
Collaborate across Production, Quality, Maintenance, Automation/Robotics, Manufacturing Engineering, EHS, IT/OT, MES, Supply Chain, Product Engineering and suppliers.

Skills

Deep dynamometer test expertise
Efficiency mapping and performance validation fluency
Torque/speed/power measurement expertise
Data-analytics capability
Effective cross-functional communicator
Technical standards, structured problem solving, risk-based decision making and controlled documentation
Data literacy: KPI definition, trend analysis, evidence-based validation and clear executive/shop-floor communication
Cross-functional influence, supplier coordination and disciplined ownership in a greenfield launch environment
Coaching, competency assessment and knowledge transfer in a multicultural English/Arabic workplace

Minimum Qualifications

Preferred Qualifications

Demonstrated experience with commissioning, FAT/SAT, launch, production readiness or high-volume manufacturing ramp within the role discipline

Ability to support site, shift, weekend, shutdown or emergency activities when operationally required
Preferred: recognized discipline certification, Lean/Six Sigma, greenfield EV/automotive launch and KSA workforce-development experience

Through technology, expertise and industry-leading research, we remain dedicated to our purpose of making our world safe, secure and resilient.At Jensen Hughes, we believe that creating and sustaining a culture of trust, integrity and professional growth starts with putting our people first. Our employees are our greatest strength, and we value the unique perspectives and talents they bring to our organization. Our wide range of Global Employee Networks connect people from across the organization, supporting career development and providing forums for individuals to share experiences on topics they're passionate about. Overview – Role

The Fire Systems Engineer - Mechanical will be a professional in the field of Fire Protection and Life Safety consulting with demonstrable experience in the design, construction and testing / commissioning phases of modern active fire protection systems.

Based in Khobar, this role will be responsible for working on wide range of projects based across Saudi Arabia.

This role offers the chance to work in a fast-paced environment and advance your career within a supportive and diverse team, to support the design and development of fire protection systems for a wide range of building types and industries. The ideal candidate is an early-career engineer with a strong interest in fire protection and a willingness to learn industry standards and software tools. A verifiable and demonstrated knowledge of design practices and approvals in KSA for Building Code and Life Safety requirements is a key requisite for this role. This also extends to the ability to engage and liaise with regulatory and approving authorities at various stages of design, construction and handover of projects.

Key Responsibilities

Design fire suppression systems such as firewater pump, firewater network, sprinkler system (wet, dry, pre-action), spray system, clean agent, kitchen hood system, etc.
Design detailed fire alarm system drawings, wiring diagrams, device layouts, riser diagrams, cause and effect matrix, and specifications
Perform voltage drop and battery calculations using specialized software (e.g., AlarmCAD, Honeywell tools)
Prepare design basis report for fire suppression system
Perform hydraulic calculations using software such as Elitefire and Pipenet
Perform theoretical calculation and can verify /interpret the flow calculation for clean agent system
Design/verify the kitchen hood fire extinguishing system
Develop schematic diagrams for fire water pumps, fire water network, sprinkler system, spray system, foam system, etc.
Prepare submittals, technical reports, and system documentation
Supervise designers to draft each fire protection system

Requirements And Qualifications

An accredited bachelor’s degree in mechanical, or related engineering field
7-12 years of experience in design and layout of mechanical or specialty engineering systems
In depth understanding of Building codes (National and International), Fire codes, NFPA 1, NFPA 13, NFPA 14, NFPA 15, NFPA 20, NFPA 22, NFPA 30, NFPA 70, NFPA 72, NFPA 101, NFPA 2001.
Good knowledge of national codes and standards such as the National Building Code, Fire Codes, and local standards like TAC, OISD, etc.
Proficiency with AutoCAD (Revit experience is a plus).
Strong analytical, communication, and organizational skills.
Excellent report writing and interpersonal skills
Ability to present clear and technically sound engineering strategies, assess review results with excellent written and spoken communication skills
Ability to work independently and as part of a team, rise to professional challenges, and endeavour to be an integral part of the long-term growth of Jensen Hughes
Have the ability and desire to deliver the desired goals (completion of the project) on time and within budget
Ready to travel as required, to meet projects requirements

description_text:
Job ID 2616352

Location , Riyadh, SA

Date Posted 2026-08-31

Category Engineering and Sciences

Subcategory Systems Engineer

Schedule Full-Time

Shift Day Job

Travel Yes - 25% of the time

Minimum Clearance Required Secret

Clearance Level Must Be Able to Obtain None

Potential for Remote Work ORA_ON_SITE

Description

SAIC is seeking Systems Engineers to support the U.S. Navy's Foreign Military Sales (FMS) C4I modernization program for the Royal Saudi Naval Forces (RSNF) on-site in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia and Jubail, Saudi Arabia in direct support of the Naval Information Warfare Systems Command (NAVWAR) program office. The Systems Engineers will lead requirements analysis, technical site surveys, system verification, and analysis of alternatives (AoA) for the integration of C4I and Commercial Off The Shelf (COTS) capabilities into RSNF platforms and shore facilities. The selected candidate will interact routinely with U.S. Government and Saudi senior military and government officials and will produce technical documentation suitable for foreign disclosure release.

Perform end-to-end systems engineering for C4I capabilities (GCCS, NAVMACS, HF/UHF/VHF radios and antennas, Tactical Data Links Link-11/16/22, CENTRIXS, Network Communications, SATCOM, ADSI, VBSS) deployed to RSNF afloat and ashore.
Conduct technical site surveys at RSNF facilities in Riyadh, Jubail, and Jeddah; capture as-built configurations and translate operational needs into engineering requirements.
Plan and execute System Operation Verification Tests (SOVTs); develop test procedures, witness installations, document discrepancies, and drive resolution.
Research and conduct Analysis of Alternatives (AoA) for COTS products (radars, GPS, AIS, Radio Direction Finding, EO cameras, GMDSS, APS, Emergency Radio, FOTN, CCTV, Video Display, VTC) and provide trade studies with recommendations.
Support Systems Engineering and Technical Reviews (SETR) including SRR, PDR, CDR, and TRR events; prepare and present engineering artifacts.
Author and sanitize technical documentation for foreign disclosure review; coordinate disclosure determinations with the U.S. Government Foreign Disclosure Office.
Interface with U.S. Government (NAVWAR program managers, GS-15 civilians, O-6 field grade officers) and senior RSNF military and government officials.
Contribute engineering inputs to the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) and brief schedule status to program leadership in MS Project and MS PowerPoint.
Identify, document, and mitigate technical risks; escalate cost, schedule, or performance impacts to the Program Manager.
Comply with all OCONUS work, security, and country-clearance requirements; maintain valid U.S. passport and Kingdom of Saudi Arabia work documentation.

Qualifications

Required Education

Bachelor's degree in an Engineering field from an accredited college or university and five (5 years’ experience.

Required Clearance

Must possess an active Secret security clearance with the ability to maintain; US Citizenship required.

Required Skills

Five or more (5+) years of experience supporting C4I systems (e.g., GCCS, NAVMACS, Tactical Data Links, Radios/Antennas, SATCOM, ADSI, or similar systems).
Three or more (3+) years of experience with COTS equipment (e.g., radars, GPS, EO cameras, GMDSS, APS, FOTN, CCTV, or VTC systems).
Experience working OCONUS in security cooperation efforts, engaging with U.S. Government or foreign senior military/government officials.
Expertise with foreign disclosure, technical documentation sanitization, site surveys, SOVTs, or AoAs of COTS products.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills related to C4I systems and network communications.

Desired Skills Or Required Certifications

Three or more (3+) years of experience with NAVWAR prime mission products and supporting Systems Engineering and Technical Reviews (SETR).
Completion of DISAM Security Cooperation Management (SCM) courses (e.g., SCM-CONUS) and/or DISAM International Affairs Certification Level 1 or above.
Experience working in austere locations (e.g., Middle Eastern nations) supporting security cooperation efforts or foreign customers.
Proficiency in developing and presenting Integrated Master Schedules (IMS) using tools like MS Project and MS PowerPoint (or similar).
Master's degree in an Engineering field from an accredited institution.

description_text:
About Lucidya

Lucidya is an AI-native Customer Experience Intelligence platform that helps organizations understand customer conversations, uncover actionable insights, and improve customer experiences through advanced AI capabilities.

As the platform continues to grow, maintaining reliable, secure, and high-performing data infrastructure is critical to supporting our customers and enabling continuous product innovation.

Our database environment spans multiple cloud platforms and hosting environments, supporting business-critical workloads, high-volume data ingestion, and multi-tenant applications. We are looking for a Database Administrator who can help strengthen our database operations, improve resilience, and ensure our data infrastructure remains reliable as we scale.

Why this role matters

Our database infrastructure is growing in both scale and complexity. With production PostgreSQL and MySQL environments running across AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and our in-Kingdom hosting environment, maintaining database availability, performance, and recoverability is essential to the reliability of our platform.

As a Database Administrator, you'll take ownership of the health and operational reliability of our production databases. You'll work on challenges that go beyond routine administration, including multi-terabyte database environments, high-availability architecture, disaster recovery, major-version upgrades, and safe database migrations.

You'll also work closely with engineering, cloud, and reliability teams to help developers make better database decisions, prevent production incidents, and improve the way database changes are designed and delivered.

If you enjoy solving complex database performance challenges, building resilient data infrastructure, and taking ownership of critical production systems, this role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

What You'll Do

Manage and maintain PostgreSQL and MySQL databases across AWS, GCP, and self-managed environments
Monitor database performance, availability, and capacity
Optimize queries, indexing, and database resource utilization
Manage backups, point-in-time recovery, and disaster recovery
Implement database replication, high availability, and failover strategies
Plan database upgrades, migrations, and safe schema changes
Maintain database security, access controls, and auditing
Automate database operations using Bash, Python, or similar tools
Troubleshoot database incidents and perform root-cause analysis
Collaborate with engineering, DevOps, SRE, and Cloud teams to improve database reliability and scalability

What success looks like (First 90-120 Days)

First 30 days:

You've developed a clear understanding of the production database estate across AWS, GCP, and SITE
You understand the existing database architecture, operational workflows, monitoring, and recovery procedures
You've built strong working relationships with the database team, Cloud Engineering, SRE, and development teams
You've identified the most significant risks and improvement opportunities across availability, performance, backup, and recovery

By day 60:

You're independently handling assigned database administration and troubleshooting activities
You've reviewed backup configurations and started validating recovery procedures for critical databases
You've identified gaps in database monitoring and alerting, including replication lag, WAL contention, autovacuum, and table bloat
You're contributing to database performance improvements and operational documentation

By day 90:

Critical database restore tests have been completed or are progressing against an agreed recovery-testing plan, with gaps documented and corrective actions defined
Key database failure scenarios are documented through practical runbooks
Database monitoring and alerting improvements have been implemented for prioritized operational risks
You're actively contributing to database reliability, performance, and incident-prevention initiatives

By day 120:

A safer database change-management process is in place, including appropriate reviews, DDL auditing, and rollback planning
A practical PostgreSQL major-upgrade roadmap has been developed, with compatibility and migration risks assessed
The high-availability approach for the SITE database environment has been evaluated and documented
Database size and activity metrics are available to support the per-customer cost-allocation initiative

Requirements

Who You Are

You're an experienced Database Administrator who understands that managing production databases is about more than keeping services running. You know how to prevent data loss, diagnose complex performance problems, plan high-risk changes, and build systems that remain reliable under pressure.

You're comfortable working with large, business-critical databases and can balance operational stability with the need to improve architecture, automation, and scalability.

Technically, you likely:

Have 5+ years of hands-on PostgreSQL administration experience in production
Have experience with AWS Aurora, Amazon RDS, MySQL, and self-managed Linux databases
Understand database performance tuning, replication, high availability, and disaster recovery
Have experience managing multi-terabyte databases, upgrades, and migrations
Can automate database operations using Bash or Python

When it comes to database resilience:

You have hands-on experience with backups, recovery, replication, and failover
You can troubleshoot database incidents and minimize downtime
You follow safe change-management practices and maintain rollback plans

When it comes to database performance:

You can troubleshoot slow queries, indexing, locking, and resource utilization
You understand PostgreSQL internals and multi-tenant database challenges

What sets you apart:

You take ownership and remain calm under pressure
You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with engineering teams
You document your work and continuously improve database reliability

Nice to Have (but not required)

Experience with multi-tenant database architectures, particularly schema-per-tenant environments with thousands of schemas
Experience managing databases larger than several terabytes with high write volumes and demanding availability requirements
Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL tooling such as Patroni, pgBackRest, or WAL-G
Experience supporting cloud migrations or moving customer workloads to in-Kingdom hosting environments
Familiarity with database observability, capacity planning, and per-customer database usage or cost allocation
Experience working in SaaS, data-platform, fintech, banking, or telecommunications environments
Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools and automated database provisioning
Relevant certifications, such as EDB PostgreSQL or AWS certifications

What the hiring process will look like

Mawhub screening 
Technical screen (45 min) — [DB Lead]
Technical deep-dive (60-90 min) with a practical scenario: diagnosing replication lag and WAL contention, planning a zero-downtime major upgrade — [DB Lead + SRE Team Lead]
Hiring manager interview — Mahmoud Moharam, Cloud Manager
Culture fit interview - HR Director

description_text:
Job description:

Job Purpose 
Responsible for analyzing and executing system testing activities to ensure applications meet defined business, functional, technical, and quality requirements, while identifying defects, managing testing risks, and supporting continuous improvement of QA processes.
Key Accountability Areas 
Process Analysis & Assessment:
Analyze software testing processes, workflows, and quality assurance procedures to identify inefficiencies, gaps, and improvement opportunities.
Conduct test process assessments to evaluate testing effectiveness, coverage, compliance, and operational quality.
Perform root cause analysis to identify underlying issues affecting software quality, testing efficiency, and defect resolution.
Assess testing dependencies, risks, controls, and potential impacts on software quality and delivery.
Process Documentation & Mapping:
Develop and maintain test documentation, including test scenarios, test cases, test scripts, test workflows, defect reports, and test execution records.
Document current-state (As-Is) and future-state (To-Be) testing processes to support quality improvement initiatives.
Define test inputs, expected outputs, validation criteria, roles, responsibilities, and performance measures.
Ensure test documentation remains accurate, up-to-date, and aligned with business and system requirements.
Process Improvement & Optimization:
Identify opportunities to streamline testing activities, improve test coverage, reduce testing cycle times, and enhance overall testing efficiency.
Apply software testing, quality assurance, continuous improvement, and testing best practices to optimize QA activities.
Develop practical testing and quality improvement recommendations based on test results, defect analysis, and operational requirements.
Evaluate the effectiveness of implemented testing improvements and recommend further optimization actions.
Requirements Analysis & Solution Development:
Gather and analyze business, functional, and technical requirements from stakeholders.
Translate business and system requirements into test scenarios, test cases, and quality validation requirements.
Assess the impact of proposed system changes on existing functionality, test coverage, and related business processes.
Support the development of test plans, testing proposals, and quality assurance activities.
Process Performance Monitoring:
Analyze test execution and defect data to identify trends, issues, quality risks, and improvement opportunities.
Prepare analytical test reports and recommendations to support project and release decision-making.
Track testing activities and measure achieved results against defined quality and testing targets.
Change Implementation & Operational Support:
Support the implementation of testing activities for new systems, enhancements, releases, and process changes.
Participate in test execution, regression testing, user acceptance testing (UAT), and operational readiness activities.
Provide testing guidance and quality-related support to business users, developers, and stakeholders.
Monitor post-release quality and support defect verification, investigation, and corrective actions where required.
Governance & Compliance:
Ensure testing activities comply with organizational QA policies, quality standards, testing procedures, and applicable requirements.
Support QA governance activities, audits, quality reviews, and compliance assessments.
Recommend standardization opportunities to improve consistency, test coverage, and quality controls across software testing activities.
Maintain QA repositories and support knowledge management initiatives related to testing processes and documentation.
Role Accountability 
HR Proficiency:
Ability to obtain updated soft and technical skills related to the job.
Delivery:
Perform the planned activities to meet the operational and development targets as per delivery schedules.
Utilize resources effectively to achieve objectives within efficient cost and time.
Provide a periodic report formatted by detailing the deviation and execution of planned tasks.
Problem-Solving:
Solve any related problems arise and escalate any complex operational issues.
Quality:
Ensure quality requirements to develop effective quality control and processes including specifications for products or processes or related activities.
Business Process Improvement:
Coordinate well-defined written systems, policies, procedures, and seek automations opportunities as much as possible.
Compliance:
Comply to related policy and procedures and work instructions.
Health, Safety, and Environment:
Ensure compliance of relevant safety, quality, and environmental management procedures and controls within defined area of work activity to guarantee safety, legislative compliance, and delivery of high-quality products/services.

description_text:
Job Description

Rejoignez notre équipe et prenez part à la conception d’expériences digitales simples, accessibles et cohérentes. En tant que Product Designer confirmé, vous interviendrez sur l’ensemble du processus de conception, depuis la compréhension des besoins utilisateurs jusqu’à la livraison et au suivi de l’implémentation.

Vous travaillerez avec les équipes Product, Design, Research, Data et Engineering pour transformer les problématiques utilisateurs et les objectifs produit en solutions concrètes. Vous contribuerez également à la qualité des interfaces, à l’utilisation du Design System et à l’amélioration des pratiques de l’équipe Design.

Vos missions


Prendre en charge des sujets de design de bout en bout, de la compréhension du problème jusqu’à la livraison.
Traduire les besoins utilisateurs, les objectifs produit et les contraintes techniques en parcours, wireframes, prototypes et interfaces haute fidélité.
Participer aux phases de discovery, de cadrage et d’exploration des solutions.
Utiliser les données disponibles, la recherche utilisateur et les retours terrain pour orienter vos choix de conception.
Concevoir des expériences accessibles et responsive, en tenant compte des différents appareils, états, cas d’usage et situations limites.
Présenter vos solutions, recueillir les feedbacks et défendre vos choix auprès des parties prenantes.
Préparer des livrables exploitables par les équipes de développement, organiser les fichiers Figma et participer aux sessions de handoff et de Design QA.
Contribuer à l’évolution du Design System, aux revues de design, au partage des bonnes pratiques et à l’amélioration des méthodes de travail de l’équipe.


Votre profil


Vous avez entre 4 et 6 ans d’expérience en Product Design, UX/UI Design ou design numérique.
Vous avez déjà travaillé sur des produits ou services digitaux, idéalement dans des environnements complexes ou impliquant plusieurs équipes.
Vous êtes capable de prendre en charge un projet ou une fonctionnalité de bout en bout.
Vous disposez d’un portfolio présentant votre démarche de conception, la qualité de vos réalisations et votre capacité à résoudre des problématiques UX/UI.
Vous maîtrisez très bien Figma, notamment les composants, variantes, Auto Layout, variables, bibliothèques et fonctionnalités de prototypage.
Vous avez une expérience opérationnelle de Figma Make.
Vous comprenez les principes des Design Systems et savez les utiliser dans un environnement produit.
Vous connaissez les standards d’accessibilité numérique, notamment les recommandations WCAG.
Vous maîtrisez les principes du responsive design.
Vous savez collaborer avec les équipes Product, Design et Engineering, présenter vos choix et gérer vos priorités.
Vous êtes attentif.ve à la qualité d’exécution, à la cohérence des interfaces et aux besoins des utilisateurs.
Vous maîtrisez le français et l’anglais, à l’écrit comme à l’oral.


Amaris Consulting s’engage à promouvoir la diversité au sein de ses effectifs et à créer un environnement de travail inclusif. Nous étudions les candidatures de toutes les personnes qualifiées, indépendamment du genre, de l’orientation sexuelle, de la race, de l’origine ethnique, des croyances, de l’âge, de l’état civil, du handicap ou de toute autre caractéristique.

Who are we?

Amaris Consulting, part of Mantu is an independent technology consulting firm providing guidance and solutions to businesses. With more than 1,000 clients across the globe, we have been rolling out solutions in major projects for over a decade – this is made possible by an international team of 7,600 people spread across 5 continents and more than 60 countries. Our solutions focus on four different Business Lines: Information System & Digital, Telecom, Life Sciences and Engineering. We’re focused on building and nurturing a top talent community where all our team members can achieve their full potential. Amaris is your steppingstone to cross rivers of change, meet challenges and achieve all your projects with success.

At Amaris, we strive to provide our candidates with the best possible recruitment experience. We like to get to know our candidates, challenge them, and be able to give them proper feedback as quickly as possible. Here's what our recruitment process looks like:

Brief Call: Our process typically begins with a brief virtual/phone conversation to get to know you! The objective? Learn about you, understand your motivations, and make sure we have the right job for you!

Interviews (the average number of interviews is 3 - the number may vary depending on the level of seniority required for the position). During the interviews, you will meet people from our team: your line manager of course, but also other people related to your future role. We will talk in depth about you, your experience, and skills, but also about the position and what will be expected of you. Of course, you will also get to know Amaris: our culture, our roots, our teams, and your career opportunities!

Case study: Depending on the position, we may ask you to take a test. This could be a role play, a technical assessment, a problem-solving scenario, etc.

As you know, every person is different and so is every role in a company. That is why we have to adapt accordingly, and the process may differ slightly at times. However, please know that we always put ourselves in the candidate's shoes to ensure they have the best possible experience.

We look forward to meeting you!

description_text:
About Noon Academy: 
Noon is a Saudi EdTech company. Noon Track runs inside schools: a hybrid programme that prepares students for Qudrat (قدرات) and Tahsili (تحصيلي), the national university-admission exams. Our students are 15 to 17 years old. Noon is becoming an AI-native company, department by department, and the number of schools we serve is growing. We believe every student deserves world-class teachers. And to make it happen, we’re reimagining everything about education: from cutting-edge tech to peer learning and physical spaces that spark curiosity.

Hear about our vision directly from our CEO here.
Learn more about us [here]

The role
You will be the one designer who owns the student experience. Primarily that means the student app: where students study, work with an AI tutor, answer questions, and take part in activities, including games and head-to-head duels on a topic. You will also shape parts of the live classroom experience.

This is a Senior/Principal-level individual contributor Product Designer role. There is no design team underneath you and no manager drawing your roadmap. You take a problem from the first student conversation to the shipped screen, and you decide what to look at next.

Why this role
One owner of the whole student experience, with a direct line to leadership.
Speed: with AI in the workflow, ideas go from research to release in days, not quarters.
An experimentation practice being built from the ground up, with you shaping it.
A company expanding into more schools, with a long-term ambition to match.

What You Will Do

Spend real time with students in Saudi schools. Interviews, focus groups, classroom observation. Turn what you hear into design decisions, and go back to check them.
Design for Saudi Arabia, not for the generic "best practice" app. Patterns that work in London or San Francisco often fail here. You know why, and you can show it in your work.
Own the student app end to end. Flows, information architecture, prototypes, final UI, and the handover to engineering.
Design activities students want to come back to, games and duels included, with learning as the gate: an activity that is more fun but teaches less is a regression.
Run experiments. State a hypothesis, build the variants, agree the metric, and read the result honestly. You will help build the experimentation practice, not just use it.
Work AI-native. Use AI tools for generation, prototyping and production so your time goes to research and judgement. We care about the quality of your decisions, not how many pixels you pushed by hand.
Work directly with the product manager and engineers. Short loops, fast releases, no layers.

About you (To be successful in this role, you should have):

Roughly 5 years of experience in UX, product design experience. We care less about the number and more about how many people you have interviewed and what you did with it.
A research practice you can describe in detail: how you recruit, what you ask, how you synthesise, how it reached the product.
A portfolio of projects that demonstrate your creativity and delivery of results through great consumer-facing mobile-first experiences
Proficiency in using various tools and techniques to create and communicate your design ideas, such as sketches, wireframes, mockups, prototypes, etc.
Experience in conducting user research and testing in different contexts and cultures, using both qualitative and quantitative methods
A strong sense of empathy, curiosity, and creativity, and a willingness to learn and experiment

Nice to have:
Game design or gaming industry experience.
Large-scale B2C or e-commerce experience, where A/B tests and small-metric optimisation were the daily rhythm.
Enough front-end to prototype in code with AI assistance.

Why Noon?

Real impact — your work directly affects how thousands of students learn every day.
Speed and autonomy — small team, big problems, zero bureaucracy.
AI-native culture — we don't just talk about AI, we build with it daily.
Well-funded — Series B closed, substantial recurring revenue, and accelerating.
Mission that matters — every student deserves world-class teachers. We're making it happen.

Benefits
In addition to a competitive base salary, we offer:

Performance-based bonus
21 days of annual leave
Full premium Medical coverage, including Family Dependent

description_text:
About Pay10
Pay10 is a global payment solutions provider with a presence across India, the UAE, Bahrain, Egypt, Hungary, Morocco and other key markets. Through its consumer and merchant platforms, Pay10 enables seamless digital payments, cross-border transfers, merchant acquiring, and value-added services, all built on world-class compliance and security standards.

Pay10 Morocco
As part of its global expansion, Pay10 has established a new regional office in Morocco, which is preparing to launch its payment activities in full compliance with Bank Al-Maghrib’s regulations. Pay10 Morocco will introduce innovative and seamless payment solutions for consumers, agents, and merchants, combining the group’s international expertise with Morocco’s dynamic and expanding financial ecosystem.

Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled Database Administrator (DBA) with hands-on expertise in MySQL and MongoDB to join our technology team. The DBA will be responsible for designing, implementing, securing, monitoring, and optimizing databases that power our mission-critical FinTech applications hosted on on-premises servers .
The role requires deep technical knowledge of RDBMS and NoSQL systems, high-availability architectures, performance tuning, and compliance with financial industry standards.

Key Responsibilities
Database Engineering & Operations (Primary)

Hybrid RDBMS & NoSQL Management: Architecture, deployment, and maintenance of high-availability MySQL and NoSQL (MongoDB) environments.
Scale & Performance: Implement and manage advanced replication, sharding, and clustering strategies to ensure 99.99% uptime for fintech applications.
Optimization: Proactively perform query optimization, schema tuning, and indexing strategies for both transactional and analytical workloads.
Data Integrity: Design and execute rigorous backup, recovery, and disaster recovery (DR) protocols, ensuring strict adherence to RPO/RTO targets.

DevOps & Automation (Secondary/Integrated)

Infrastructure as Code: Automate database provisioning and configuration using tools like Terraform and Ansible.
CI/CD Integration: Support the DevOps team in streamlining application deployment pipelines (Jenkins/GitLab) involving database schema changes.
Monitoring & Observability: Build and maintain comprehensive dashboards using Prometheus, Grafana, and Percona Monitoring to ensure full-stack visibility.
Security & Compliance: Align database security with global standards (PCI-DSS, SOC), managing encryption at rest/transit and fine-grained access control.

Technical Requirements

Databases: Deep expertise in MySQL. Strong proficiency in NoSQL concepts (document, key-value, or column-family); specific experience with MongoDB is highly preferred, but candidates with heavy experience in other NoSQL systems (e.g., Cassandra, DynamoDB, Redis) and a willingness to adapt are encouraged to apply.
DevOps Toolkit: Hands-on experience with Linux administration, Docker, and automation scripting (Python, Bash, or Go).
Cloud & On-Prem: Experience managing databases in hybrid environments (AWS/On-premises).
FinTech Experience: Prior experience in a regulated financial services or payment gateway environment is a significant plus.

description_text:
UI/UX Designer — B8ak

Location: Khobar, Saudi Arabia or Remote
Team: Product
Type: Full-time

About B8ak
B8ak is a home services marketplace in Saudi Arabia. Customers book cleaning and maintenance through our app and web platform; thousands of vetted service professionals pick up that work and get paid through us. We've served well over 180,000 customers since launch, and the business runs on high frequency — our customers come back often, which means every friction point in the booking flow shows up in the numbers quickly.

The role
You'll own the end-to-end experience of a two-sided marketplace: the customer booking a cleaner for Thursday morning, and the technician managing their day's jobs. These are very different users with very different constraints, and the product only works when both sides do.
This is a hands-on design role with real ownership. You'll work directly with Product, Engineering, Growth and Operations, and you'll see the impact of your work in conversion and repeat-booking data within weeks.

What you'll do

Design flows, screens and components for the B8ak customer app, service-provider app, and web platform — from first sketch to production-ready specs
Own the booking funnel: service selection, scheduling, address and basket, checkout. Reducing drop-off here is the single highest-leverage design problem we have.
Optimize the booking funnel to yield better conversion page-to-page. 
Improve the first-time-to-repeat experience — onboarding, post-service follow-up, rebooking and loyalty surfaces.
Design for the provider side: job acceptance, scheduling, navigation, earnings and ratings.
Build and maintain our design system across Arabic (RTL) and English (LTR), iOS, Android and web
Run usability sessions with Saudi customers and with service professionals in the field, and turn what you learn into concrete design changes.
Partner with Growth on A/B tests — basket size, pricing presentation, lifecycle messaging — and design the variants properly rather than as afterthoughts.
Work with engineers through implementation and QA so what ships matches what was designed.
Full understanding of agile development and JIRA work environment. 

What we're looking for
4+ years designing digital products, with at least 2 years on consumer mobile apps.
A portfolio showing shipped work, with clear reasoning about the problem, the constraints and the outcome — not just polished screens
Strong command of Figma, including components, variants, auto-layout and prototyping
Real experience designing bilingual Arabic/English products with proper RTL handling. This is not a nice-to-have for us.
Comfort with data: you can read a funnel, form a hypothesis about where users are struggling, and design against it.
Working knowledge of iOS and Android platform conventions and what is realistic to build
Fluency in Arabic and English.
Strong AI fluency to expedite deliverables. 

Bonus points
Marketplace, on-demand, delivery or logistics experience.
Experience designing for field workers or blue-collar users, especially on low-end devices and patchy connections.
Familiarity with lifecycle and CRM tools (WebEngage, Braze, CleverTap).
Service design or operations-facing tooling experience.
Motion design, or front-end familiarity (HTML/CSS).

What we offer
A product used every day by households across the Kingdom, with immediate and visible impact.
Design ownership of a core surface rather than ticket-taking.
A fast team where decisions get made in days, not quarters.
Competitive salary, medical insurance, and standard Saudi benefits.
On-site work with great work environment in Khobar city, we are also open to hire remotely with the right talents.

IBM Cloud Pak for Integration (CP4I)
App Connect Enterprise (ACE): Troubleshoot message flows, ESQL logic errors, and adapter connectivity issues (SAP, Database, File).
IBM MQ: Manage queue managers, resolve channel retries, and investigate dead-letter queues or message persistence issues.
API Connect: Resolve issues related to API definitions, security policies, and Gateway (DataPower) latency.
Backend Microservices (Spring Boot)
Performance Tuning: Analyze JVM thread dumps and heap dumps to resolve memory leaks or high CPU utilization in microservices.
Connectivity Debugging: Troubleshoot Spring Boot integration with databases (JPA/Hibernate) and external messaging systems (JMS/Kafka).
Log Aggregation: Utilize ELK/Splunk to correlate logs across multiple microservices to identify points of failure in a distributed architecture.

Integration Platforms: Mastery of IBM CP4I (specifically ACE, MQ, and API Connect).
Development Frameworks: Advanced knowledge of Java and Spring Boot (Spring Integration, Spring Cloud).
Containerization: Expert-level proficiency in Red Hat OpenShift and Kubernetes.
Protocols & Standards: Expert understanding of REST, SOAP, JSON, XML, AMQP, and MQTT.
Monitoring Tools: Hands-on experience with IBM Instana, Dynatrace, or Prometheus/Grafana.
Qualifications
Experience: 5+ years in Middleware or Integration Support
Currently residing in KSA
Complex Problem Solving: Ability to debug asynchronous communication patterns and distributed transactions.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
Certifications (Preferred): IBM Cloud Pak for Integration Specialist, Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Administration.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Integration Uptime: Achieving 99.99% availability for critical middleware components.
L2 Resolution Rate: Maximizing the number of integration issues resolved without escalation to L3 Engineering.
MTTR: Reducing the time taken to identify and fix failures in the message delivery pipeline.

description_text:
We are looking for a curious, detail-oriented, and ambitious Database Administrator Trainee to join our Data Platform team through the Tamheer Program.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, analyzing system behavior, working with data, and understanding how critical technology platforms operate behind the scenes.

As a DBA Trainee, you will gain hands-on exposure to production-scale database environments and learn how databases are designed, monitored, optimized, secured, backed up, and recovered.

Database administration requires precision and responsibility. A small configuration or query mistake can sometimes have a significant impact. Therefore, we are looking for someone who approaches tasks carefully, validates their work, asks the right questions, and remains calm when investigating technical problems.

This will be a challenging learning journey filled with technical exploration, troubleshooting, benchmarking, automation, and real-world engineering experience.

Key Responsibilities

You will work closely with experienced Database Administrators, Data Engineers, and Platform Engineers to:

Write, review, and optimize SQL queries
Analyze database performance and identify slow or inefficient queries
Support database monitoring, health checks, and capacity analysis
Assist with database backup, recovery, replication, and high-availability activities
Investigate database incidents and help identify root causes
Perform benchmarking and compare database configurations, queries, and technologies
Develop Python scripts to automate repetitive database and operational tasks
Validate data accuracy, consistency, and integrity
Prepare technical reports, performance findings, and recommendations
Support documentation of database standards, operational procedures, and best practices
Learn how database changes are safely tested before being applied to critical environments
Participate in continuous improvement initiatives across the Data Platform

Requirements

The ideal candidate should have:

Good foundational knowledge of SQL
The ability to write queries using joins, aggregations, filtering, and subqueries
Basic Python programming skills
Strong critical-thinking and problem-solving abilities
An analytical mindset and close attention to detail
The ability to compare results, benchmark solutions, and validate assumptions
A willingness to investigate problems instead of accepting results at face value
Good communication and documentation skills
A strong desire to learn database technologies and production engineering practices

Preferred Knowledge

The following experience is beneficial but not mandatory:

Familiarity with MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, or similar database technologies
Basic knowledge of Linux and command-line tools
Understanding of database indexes, transactions, schemas, and data types
Exposure to Git, APIs, cloud platforms, or container technologies
Experience working on academic, personal, or graduation projects involving data or automation

What You Will Learn

During the program, you will have the opportunity to learn:

How enterprise databases operate at scale
Database performance tuning and query optimization
Backup, recovery, replication, and disaster-recovery concepts
Database security and access-management practices
Monitoring, alerting, and incident investigation
Python-based database automation
Safe change-management practices for production environments
How to think and operate like a Database Reliability Engineer

Who Will Succeed in This Role?

You will enjoy this role if you:

Are curious about how systems work internally
Enjoy investigating difficult technical problems
Pay attention to small details that others may overlook
Are comfortable asking questions and learning from feedback
Take ownership of your work and verify your results
See challenges as opportunities to learn and improve
Want to build a career in databases, cloud data platforms, or reliability engineering

Our Commitment to You

You will not be expected to know everything from day one.

You will receive guidance, practical experience, and opportunities to work with experienced engineers. At the same time, we will challenge you to think critically, research independently, test your ideas, and gradually take ownership of meaningful technical tasks.

This is more than a training opportunity. It is an adventure into the world of databases, where reliability, accuracy, automation, and engineering discipline come together to support systems used at scale.

description_text:
About Lucidya

Lucidya is an AI-native platform for customer experience (CX) intelligence that helps organizations understand their customers and take action across the entire customer lifecycle.

Our platform brings together products including Social Listening, OmniServe, Survey, and AI Agent, helping enterprise organizations across the region turn customer data into better experiences and measurable business outcomes.

As Lucidya continues to scale, our products are becoming more sophisticated and our customers more demanding. Design has an increasingly important role to play in making sure that complexity doesn't become the customer's problem.

Why this role matters

At this level, we're looking for someone who can move beyond simply executing designs and own problems from beginning to end.

You'll take ambiguous customer and business problems, work with Product and Engineering to understand what we're trying to achieve, explore different approaches, and drive the design through to implementation and iteration.

You'll be working on products that can involve significant amounts of data, complex workflows, AI-powered functionality, and bilingual experiences. The challenge isn't simply making these products look good — it's making them easy to understand, efficient to use, and genuinely useful for enterprise customers.

You'll have meaningful independence, but you're not expected to operate alone. You'll work alongside senior designers, Product Managers, Engineers, UX researchers, and UX writers. The strongest person in this role will know when to push their own thinking, when to ask for input, and when to challenge an assumption.

What You'll Do

Own design problems end-to-end. You'll take ownership from understanding the problem and defining the user experience through wireframes, prototypes, high-fidelity UI, handoff, implementation, and post-launch iteration. 
Turn ambiguity into clarity. Requirements won't always arrive perfectly defined. You'll work with Product, Engineering, Research, and stakeholders to understand the underlying problem and determine what we actually need to solve. 
Design for outcomes, not outputs. You'll challenge solutions that don't clearly improve the customer's experience and use research, data, and customer feedback to understand whether your designs are actually working. 
Partner closely with Product and Engineering. You'll be involved early rather than receiving requirements at the end of the process. You'll help shape what gets built and work through technical and product constraints without losing sight of the customer. 
Raise the quality of our products. You'll contribute to Lucidya's design system and help create consistency across our products while knowing when a problem requires something different. 
Bring customer evidence into design decisions. You'll conduct or support usability testing and lightweight research, using what you learn to validate assumptions rather than relying solely on personal opinion. 
Make complex products feel simple. Whether you're designing analytics, workflows, AI functionality, or customer-facing experiences, you'll look for ways to reduce cognitive load and help users get to the outcome they need faster. 
Design thoughtfully for our market. You'll account for Arabic and English experiences, RTL considerations, and the needs of enterprise customers across the region. 
Communicate your thinking clearly. You'll present work to Product, Engineering, leadership, and other stakeholders, explaining not only what you designed but why you made those decisions. 
Make the team better. You'll actively participate in critiques, give thoughtful feedback to other designers, and share what you've learned rather than keeping your knowledge within your own product area

Requirements

Who You Are

You can own a problem without needing someone to tell you every step. You know how to take an ambiguous brief, ask the right questions, break it down, and move it forward. 
You think like a product designer, not just a UI designer. You're interested in the customer, the business problem, the constraints, and the outcome — not simply whether the final interface looks polished. 
You're comfortable challenging the status quo. If you think a requirement doesn't make sense or there's a better way to solve a problem, you're willing to say so and can back your thinking with evidence. 
You know when to push and when to compromise. You can defend an important design decision while understanding that product development involves technical, commercial, and time constraints. 
You're highly collaborative. You don't throw designs over the wall to Engineering or wait for Product to tell you what to do. You work with people throughout the process. 
You're comfortable with ambiguity and change. Priorities may shift, requirements may evolve, and not every decision will be made for you. You stay focused on the outcome rather than becoming frustrated by the process. 
You're genuinely curious about users. You want to understand why customers behave the way they do and are willing to change your design when the evidence tells you that your original assumption was wrong. 
You communicate with clarity. You can explain complex design decisions to people who aren't designers and can adapt how you communicate depending on whether you're speaking with an Engineer, Product Manager, customer, or executive. 
You care about quality. You have high standards for interaction, usability, accessibility, and visual design, but you also understand when "good enough to learn" is better than spending weeks perfecting something nobody has validated. 
You have 3-5 years of product design or UX/UI experience, ideally in B2B or SaaS environments, with a portfolio demonstrating genuine end-to-end product thinking. 
You're proficient in Figma and comfortable with prototyping, design systems, and modern product design practices. 
You're a Saudi national, as this position is designated for Saudi nationals. 

Nice to Have

Experience designing data-heavy or analytics-driven B2B products. 
Experience with AI-powered products, conversational interfaces, or AI agents. 
Experience designing Arabic/English or RTL experiences. 
Familiarity with tools such as FigJam, Maze, LogRocket, or similar research and testing tools. 

What the hiring process will look like

Recruiter screening — An initial conversation about your experience, motivations, and what you're looking for next. 
Design interview — A deeper discussion with the Design team around your product thinking, design process, and approach to solving complex problems. 
Portfolio / case study presentation — You'll take us through selected projects, focusing on the problem, your role, decisions, trade-offs, collaboration, and measurable or observable outcomes. 
Team / culture interview — A conversation focused on how you work, give and receive feedback, handle disagreement, and contribute to a high-performing team. 
Final interview — Final conversation with the relevant leadership team

description_text:
About Jeeny:

Jeeny is a leading ride-hailing platform that strives to revolutionize daily commuting and transportation. Our app connects users with their preferred modes of transportation, making mobility accessible, convenient, and affordable for all.

We are a joint venture between MEIG (Middle East Internet Group), Rocket Internet, and IMENA. Since our inception, we have grown exponentially and currently operate in Saudi Arabia and Jordan.

At Jeeny, we value innovation, teamwork, and a passion for delivering exceptional user experiences. Join us in our mission to transform the transportation landscape.

About the Role:

We are looking for a Lead Product Designer who can come and lead a team of product designers at Jeeny and take UX research to next level.

Job Responsibilities:

Lead a team of PDs or APDs and contribute towards their personal development
Manage and guide on constant user experience research and user testing
Produce and review comprehensive discoveries from user research on a regular basis
Prioritize design backlogs and manage design sprints
Review the work done by the team on a regular basis
Track, report and achieve relevant metrics and KPIs on a regular level
Build short term and long term design strategy
Represent the design team on multiple forums and conduct thought workshops

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. MBA or advanced degree preferred
At least 5 years of experience in Product for user-facing mobile and web applications
Experience of working for tech companies in transportation, deliveries and eCommerce space will be preferred
Experience of working in the middle east (esp KSA and Jordan) will be preferred
Native Arabic speaker will be preferred

Benefits

What We Offer:

An opportunity to collaborate with talented individuals while learning, growing, and expanding your skill set
An environment that encourages you to take ownership and produce excellent outcomes every day
Health benefits and insurance
Flexible working hours

Company Culture

Jeeny is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing a workplace where all aspects of employment are solely based on merit. We value diversity and absolutely do not discriminate in any form based on race, color, ethnicity, nationality, religion, gender, age, or mental or physical disability.
